For us, sustainability starts with the ingredient. We work with seasonal produce, high levels of organic ingredients, local producers and reducing food waste.
We want to raise the bar for how sustainability is approached in gastronomy – without compromising flavour or the guest experience.

We value respect, collaboration, responsibility and the desire to keep improving.

A modern French-Japanese kitchen focusing on deep umami, precision, seasonal ingredients and a minimum of 60% organic produce. A small, focused team with high gastronomic ambitions.

A vibrant restaurant inspired by San Francisco’s Mission District, serving creative sharing-style dishes with seasonal ingredients in a relaxed atmosphere.

A modern Nordic restaurant with more than 15 years of history. The restaurant focuses on organic and seasonal ingredients, local producers, vegetables and fish from Nordic waters.LOCA also operates
Kilden i Haven in Tivoli and several canteens.

What we offer

  • A workplace with high gastronomic ambitions.

  • An international and diverse working environment.

  • Passionate and dedicated colleagues.

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.

  • Responsibility and influence in your daily work.

  • Opportunities for further training and development within LOCA.

You become part of a community where we share knowledge, support each other and work together to create great meals and great workplaces.We believe Every Meal Matters – and that the choices we make today help create a better world tomorrow.Practical information

title: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers
After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

title: Fast job lørdag og søndag med kørsel og rengøring – Dianalund/Midt- og Vestsjælland
description:
Fast weekendjob lørdag og søndag med kørsel og rengøring – Dianalund / Midt- og Vestsjælland

Stillingen er på 8-8,5 timer hver lørdag og 8-8,5 timer hver søndag, i alt 16-17 timer om ugen.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Kan følge en fast rute og arbejdsplan

  • Er grundig og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Er komfortabel med, at en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår bag rattet

  • Kan arbejde fast både lørdag og søndag

  • En fast weekendstilling på 16-17 timer om ugen

  • Fast arbejde hver lørdag og søndag

  • Firmabil til al kørsel i forbindelse med arbejdet

Arbejdsområde: Midt- og Vestsjælland

English

Permanent Weekend Job Saturday and Sunday – Driving and Cleaning – Dianalund / Central and West Zealand

We are looking for a reliable and responsible employee for a permanent weekend position involving cleaning and driving between various commercial locations across Central and West Zealand.

The position is 8-8.5 hours every Saturday and 8-8.5 hours every Sunday, for a total of 16-17 hours per week.

Working hours are generally 07:00–15:00, but the schedule can also be arranged to start earlier or later in the day by agreement.

About the job

Your working day will start and finish in Dianalund, from where you will drive a planned route between different commercial locations.

The route includes areas such as Roskilde, Holbæk, Sorø and Slagelse.

All driving related to the job is carried out in a company vehicle, which is used throughout the entire route from the start of the working day in Dianalund until the route is completed back in Dianalund.

The job consists approximately of:

  • 65% driving between the different locations

  • 35% cleaning at the commercial sites

The cleaning tasks include general commercial cleaning, such as cleaning toilets, floors and common areas, as well as refilling consumable supplies.

We expect that you

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Are reliable, punctual and responsible

  • Are able to work independently

  • Can follow a planned route and work schedule

  • Take pride in delivering good-quality work

  • Are comfortable spending a large part of the working day driving

  • Are available to work regularly on both Saturdays and Sundays

Previous cleaning experience is an advantage, but not a requirement, as training will be provided.

We offer

  • Good salary and employment conditions

  • A permanent weekend position of 16-17 hours per week

  • Regular work every Saturday and Sunday

  • A company vehicle for all driving related to the job

  • Flexibility in scheduling working hours by agreement

  • A high degree of independence and responsibility

  • A varied working day combining driving and practical cleaning tasks

  • A planned and manageable route

title: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

title: KS3 and IGCSE English Teacher (Year 7 – Year 11)
description:
International School Ikast-Brande (ISIB) is looking for a qualified Cambridge English teacher with experience teaching English to students from Year 7 – Year 11. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience teaching IGCSE First Language English and are native speakers. Interviews will be arranged immediately as the Leadership Team would like to recruit as soon as possible.  

This is a full-time, permanent & pensionable position starting as soon as possible. As an inclusive school, we encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We value the richness that diverse perspectives and lived experiences bring to our community, and we are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where every individual feels respected and supported.  

 

The School: 

International School Ikast-Brande is located in the heart of Denmark and has approximately 200 students across Early Years, Primary and Secondary sections, with one class per year group. Our students are highly motivated and speak very positively about the school. We are committed to providing high-quality international education to families relocating to Denmark, as well as to local families seeking a rigorous international curriculum for their children.  

Our student body is wonderfully diverse, representing a wide range of nationalities and cultural backgrounds. We encourage our students to balance academic achievement with a well-rounded, healthy lifestyle. From an early age, we instil in them a strong sense of right and wrong, empowering them to make thoughtful and responsible decisions. As a result, we enjoy a positive school climate with very few behavioural issues.  

Our teaching team is as vibrant and international as our student body. You will often hear laughter coming from our staffroom and in the corridors. Our team meets regularly to collaborate on educational and operational matters, fostering a collegial and supportive environment.  

 

Requirements: 

In line with the school’s overarching policies and procedures, the successful candidate will be expected to: 

  • Plan and develop engaging & high-quality lessons, tailored to our learners’ needs; 

  • Maintain a student-focused, positive approach to teaching and learning; 

  • Deliver dynamic, stimulating and culturally engaging lessons;  

  • Promote student wellbeing through an understanding of each child’s individuality;  

  • Assess and report on students’ progress effectively;  

  • Manage student behaviour in a positive and constructive manner;  

  • Participate actively in whole-school activities and events;  

  • Employ a solutions-focused mindset;  

  • Maintain a great sense of humour and contribute to a positive work environment;  

  • Be internationally minded and a collaborative team player. 

 

What We Can Offer: 

  • A competitive salary and excellent pension scheme, in line with collective agreements; 

  • A genuine and sustainable work-life balance; 

  • State-of-the-art, modern teaching and learning facilities; 

  • Small class sizes with engaged, capable and curious students; 

  • A calm and respectful learning environment, with motivated and well-disciplined pupils; 

  • A flexible working culture, built on mutual trust and professional autonomy; 

  • A supportive and visible Senior Leadership Team, deeply committed to staff and community wellbeing; 

  • A leadership approach that values collaboration, open dialogue and teacher voice - ensuring staff feel heard, empowered and appreciated; 

  • A culturally diverse, inclusive and welcoming team of professionals; 

  • Strong, constructive partnerships with engaged and supportive parents; 

  • Ongoing professional learning, development opportunities and team-building events. 

 

What Denmark Can Offer: 

Living and working in Denmark offers a unique opportunity to enjoy one of the world’s highest standards of living. Teachers benefit from: 

  • An excellent work-life balance supported by a strong social welfare system; 

  • A safe, clean and well-organised society with low levels of crime; 

  • High-quality, publicly funded healthcare and childcare services; 

  • A focus on family life, personal wellbeing and professional respect; 

  • Beautiful natural surroundings; 

  • Easy access to travel across Denmark, Europe and further afield; 

  • An international community that welcomes newcomers and supports integration; 

  • A strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. 

 

Salary: 

Salary and pension are determined in accordance with the collective agreement and union contract established between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Teachers’ Central Organisation. 

Please note that both local and international teachers are employed under the same pay scales and working conditions. 

While the school does not offer formal relocation packages, we are committed to supporting new staff and work closely with individuals to find practical and helpful solutions throughout their transition. To further assist international staff with their move, initial relocation support is provided during the first year of employment. 

 

Application: 

If you are a skilled, adaptable and solutions-oriented educator, we warmly invite you to apply by sending your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience to job@isib.dk. Letters of recommendation are also welcomed. All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory police security checks.   

The Senior Leadership Team intends to appoint as soon as a suitable candidate is identified to ensure a smooth transition to our school; therefore, interviews will take place on a rolling basis, and the school reserves the right to make an appointment before the advertised closing date.

title: Frederik på 8 år i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

title: PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING
description:
PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

Ø  Follow company procedures for quality, safety and production.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be formally trained as a welder or have a vocational qualification. We are looking for someone who:

Ø  Has experience from manufacturing, metalworking, machine operation or a similar production environment – experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ø  Has a good technical understanding and enjoys working with machines.

Ø  Is practical, reliable and willing to learn.

Ø  Can work independently but also contributes positively to the team.

Ø  Has a strong focus on quality and safety.

Ø  Is comfortable with repetitive production tasks and physical work.

Ø  Can understand basic instructions, measurements and simple technical information.

Ø  Is able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Training and introduction

Full training will be provided. You will receive a structured introduction to the machines, production processes, quality requirements and safety procedures. Previous experience with automatic welding or rolling is therefore not essential.

What we offer

A stable position in a modern production environment.

Thorough training and support from experienced colleagues.

A practical and varied working day.

A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are important.

Good opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on more responsibility over time.

Competitive salary and employment conditions according to qualifications and experience.

Working environment

You will become part of a team where we value cooperation, respect and a good working atmosphere. We believe that good production results are created by people who work together, help each other and take responsibility for their work.

Working hours

The position is day shift and 37 hours / week

Location

Tcomp | Tjæreborg Kompensatorfabrik A/S,  Kærvej 19, 6731 Tjæreborg, Denmark

 

How to apply

If you are interested in working in Denmark and believe this could be the right opportunity for you, we would like to hear from you. Please send your CV and a short application explaining your experience and motivation.

Applications should be sent to: ng.sandberg@tcomp.dk

Application deadline: 10-10-2026

Start date: 19-10-2026

About us

Tcomp is a Danish manufacturing company based in Tjæreborg, near Esbjerg. We specialize in metal production and manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and reliable solutions for our customers.

We are a hands-on company where teamwork, safety and respect for each other are important parts of everyday life. We believe that good results are created by skilled and committed people working together.

Important information for international applicants

This position is based in Denmark. Candidates from EU/EEA countries and Switzerland are welcome to apply. Candidates who require a residence and work permit must meet the applicable Danish immigration requirements.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

title: Project Coordinator in Product and Supply
description:
Project Coordinator – Product & Supply

Do you enjoy creating structure, improving processes, and coordinating projects across different teams? Are you highly organized, analytical, and motivated by making operations run more efficiently? Then you might be our new Project Coordinator.

As Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in driving smaller projects and continuous process improvements within our Product & Supply organization. You will work closely with stakeholders across different departments to map, optimize, and maintain operational processes while ensuring consistency and efficiency throughout the supply chain.

Your responsibilities

As our new Project Coordinator, you will:

  • Lead and coordinate smaller internal projects within the Product & Supply organization

  • Drive updates and continuous improvements to operational processes and procedures

  • Map, document, and analyze current supply chain processes

  • Develop, align, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across departments

  • Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical improvement initiatives

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather input and ensure alignment

  • Support timely execution of both operational tasks and longer-term initiatives

  • Facilitate recurring process reviews and operational performance updates

  • Participate in process discovery and optimization workshops

  • Gather and analyze operational data to support reporting and decision-making

  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

Who you are

We imagine that you are a structured and proactive professional who enjoys working with both people and processes. You are naturally curious and have a strong desire to understand how things work and how they can be improved.

Additionally, you:

  • Have a strong attention to detail and a systematic approach to problem-solving

  • Can manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously

  • Thrive in a dynamic environment and work well independently

  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across teams

  • Possess excellent communication skills

  • Have experience working with SharePoint

  • Have an interest in business intelligence tools and data analysis

  • Have advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data modelling

What we offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative and ambitious Product & Supply team where you can make a visible impact on how we work. You will have the opportunity to work across functions, contribute to important operational improvements, and develop your project coordination and process optimization skills in a supportive environment.

title: Børnehaveklasseleder søges til Hareskov Skole
description:
Stillingen er på fuld tid og til besættelse pr. 1. december 2026 eller før, hvis muligt.

 

Vil du være med?

Hvis du er børnehaveklasseleder - eller pædagog med en drøm om at blive det - og hvis du brænder for dit job – ja, så brænder vi for at se dig!

Vi elsker at lave skole, og spørger du os, er vi faktisk ret gode til det. Her i Hareskoven passer vi nemlig rigtig godt på hinanden, og når vi gør det, bliver vi endnu bedre til at skabe læring, trivsel og gode fællesskaber for alle vores herlige elever.

Vi er helt overbeviste om, at fælles øjenhøjde, tillid og personlig frihed skaber ansvarlige og motiverede medarbejdere, og vi er faktisk ret stolte af, at det har kendetegnet os gennem alle årene. 

I denne stilling bliver du en del af vores team omkring børnehaveklasseårgangen, som består af 3 børnehaveklasseledere og 3 FFO-pædagoger. Du vil desuden samarbejde med de kommende 1. klasselærere. 


Hvad håber vi så, at du er rundet af?

  • Du har kendskab til hverdagen i en børnehaveklasse – enten som børnehaveklasseleder eller tilknyttet pædagog. 
  • Du har en anerkendende tilgang til børn og deres familier.
  • Du har øje for værdien af et tæt og forpligtende teamsamarbejde.
  • Du arbejder relationelt med blik for såvel udfordringer som styrker hos hver enkelt barn.
  • Du er tydelig og tæt kommunikerende i forældresamarbejdet.
  • Du har viden og erfaring inden for etablering af tydelige strukturer, visuel stilladsering og forudsigelighed.
  • Du interesserer dig for børns personlige, sociale og faglige udvikling; herunder den første skrive- og læseindlæring.
  • Du ser spændende perspektiver i vores fokus på inkluderende fællesskaber.
  • Du elsker at grine, og du ser din arbejdsplads som et sted, hvor man også kan hygge sig og være en del af sociale fællesskaber. 
  • Du ser spændende perspektiver i at have din gang på en folkeskole i et særdeles ressourcestærkt område, men du er enig med os i, at arbejdet med trivsel, fællesskaber, dannelse og ligeværd udgør en fundamental del af din kerneopgave. Vi ønsker nemlig at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle og opfatter faglighed som meget mere end boglighed. 

 

Hvem er vi?

Vi baserer vores arbejdsfællesskab på en fast overbevisning om, at vi alle vil hinanden det bedste. Ledelse og medarbejdere er i høj grad hinandens medspillere, og alle faggrupper anses for ligeværdige og helt essentielle for vores bestræbelse på at lave den bedst tænkelige skole. Desuden er det vigtigt for os at sige, at det er okay at fejle i denne bestræbelse, og det gør vi alle sammen hver eneste dag. Vi forventer derfor heller ikke, at du kommer til os med andet end, hvad der er dig – med alle dine kompetencer og gode egenskaber og med dine fejl.  

 

… og i et bredere perspektiv:

Hareskov Skole er en stor folkeskole i Furesø Kommune. Vi ligger i dejlige, grønne omgivelser ved Hareskoven med S-tog lige til døren - og for de friske ligger skolen i cykelafstand til København. Vi huser ca. 740 elever i almendelen og ca. 40 elever i vores Gruppeordning. 

 

Her til sidst skal du vide… 

At her på Hareskov Skole elsker vi at diskutere, vi nyder at se ting lykkes, vi bestræber os hver dag på at leve op til vores gode ry, vi hjælper hinanden og ”rykker sammen i bussen”, når det gælder, vi husker at grine – og ikke mindst holder vi altid fokus på, hvem det hele handler om – menneskene på Hareskov Skole!

 

Det formelle:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst og ud fra principperne om Ny Løn. Du kan få mere at vide om skolen på www.hareskovskole.dk


Ansøgningsfrist:

Tirsdag d. 20. oktober kl. 08.00

Bemærk: Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler tirsdag d. 27. oktober i tidsrummet fra kl. 12-17. Vi har sjældent mulighed for at flytte rundt på samtaletidspunkterne, så vi beder dig om at reservere hele tidsrummet på forhånd. 

Ønsker du at vide mere, kan du kontakte afdelingsleder for Børnemiljøet, Anja Kamp Elving (se kontaktinfo).

 

 

Praktisk

Der indhentes referencer fra tidligere ansættelsesforhold, hvis du kommer i betragtning til stillingen.

I Furesø Kommune sker løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og ud fra principperne i Ny Løn.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at din private e-mail og/ eller telefonnummer bliver videregivet til faglig organisation i forbindelse med forhandling af løn.

 

Job i Furesø? Kom og vær med!
I Furesø skaber vi løsninger sammen. Med kolleger på tværs af organisationen. Med brugere og borgere – ja med alle, vi er kommune for.
Fællesskaberne er vores svar på de udfordringer, vores velfærdssamfund står foran i de kommende år, hvor flere får brug for velfærdsydelser og over længere tid. Og hvor nye ideer derfor skal forny den service, vi yder.

Derfor giver vi plads til mødet mellem fagene og mellem mennesker, for det er her, innovationen opstår. Vi koordinerer med hinanden på tværs af titler og fagligheder, og vi holder godt styr på den daglige drift for at skabe sammenhæng for vores borgere. Vores hverdag har fokus på nærvær fremfor fravær på en sund arbejdsplads med røgfri arbejdstid. Så kom og vær med. Vi har også plads til dig.

title: Rengøringsleder søges til MB Rengøring ApS
description:
MB Rengøring ApS søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst rengøringsleder til en fuldtidsstilling

MB Rengøring ApS er en virksomhed i udvikling, som leverer professionelle rengørings- og serviceydelser til erhvervskunder på forskellige lokationer. Vi oplever en stigende aktivitet og søger derfor en engageret og struktureret rengøringsleder, som kan være med til at sikre en stabil og effektiv daglig drift samt høj kvalitet i vores leverancer til kunderne.

Som rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i virksomheden og bliver ansvarlig for koordinering, planlægning og opfølgning på den daglige rengøringsdrift. Du vil fungere som bindeled mellem ledelsen, medarbejderne og vores kunder og vil derfor have en vigtig funktion i forhold til både kvalitet, kundetilfredshed og medarbejdernes daglige arbejde.

Stillingen indebærer et betydeligt selvstændigt ansvar, og vi forventer, at du kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag, prioritere opgaver og sikre, at vores aftaler med kunderne bliver overholdt.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet bestå af planlægning og koordinering af den daglige rengøring hos virksomhedens kunder. Du skal være med til at sikre, at de rette medarbejdere bliver fordelt på de rette opgaver, og at arbejdsplanerne tilpasses efter kundernes behov, ferie, sygdom, ændringer i bemanding og øvrige driftsmæssige forhold.

Du vil have ansvar for løbende kvalitetskontrol af det udførte arbejde. Dette indebærer blandt andet kontrolbesøg hos kunder, opfølgning på rengøringsstandarder og sikring af, at medarbejderne følger virksomhedens arbejdsbeskrivelser, procedurer og kvalitetskrav. Hvis der konstateres mangler eller fejl, forventes det, at du følger op og sørger for, at forholdene bliver rettet hurtigt og professionelt.

En vigtig del af jobbet vil være oplæring og vejledning af rengøringsmedarbejdere. Du skal kunne introducere nye medarbejdere til arbejdsopgaverne, forklare virksomhedens metoder og kvalitetskrav samt følge op på deres arbejde. Du skal desuden være med til at sikre, at medarbejderne arbejder effektivt, sikkert og i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens retningslinjer.

Du vil også have løbende kontakt med vores kunder. Det kan eksempelvis være i forbindelse med ændringer i arbejdsopgaver, ekstra rengøring, særlige ønsker, kvalitetsopfølgning eller andre forhold vedrørende den daglige drift. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan kommunikere professionelt og serviceminded og samtidig finde praktiske løsninger, når der opstår ændringer eller udfordringer.

Stillingen omfatter desuden opfølgning på igangværende opgaver og sikring af, at aftalte deadlines overholdes. Du vil være med til at håndtere akutte situationer, eksempelvis sygdom blandt medarbejdere, ændringer fra kunder eller behov for ekstra bemanding. Det kræver, at du kan reagere hurtigt, finde løsninger og sikre, at kunden fortsat modtager den aftalte service.

Du vil ligeledes få ansvar for fordeling af arbejdsopgaver blandt medarbejderne og for at følge op på, om arbejdet bliver udført inden for den forventede tid og kvalitet. Det forventes, at du løbende kommunikerer med medarbejderne og støtter dem i deres daglige arbejde.

Praktisk deltagelse i rengøringsopgaver kan forekomme efter behov. Det kan eksempelvis være i forbindelse med opstart af nye kunder, oplæring af medarbejdere, kvalitetskontrol, sygdomsdækning eller særlige opgaver. Hovedvægten i stillingen vil dog være på koordinering, planlægning, kvalitetssikring og den daglige driftsledelse.

Arbejdet vil primært foregå på forskellige kundeadresser, og der vil derfor ikke nødvendigvis være ét fast arbejdssted. Du skal være indstillet på at bevæge dig mellem forskellige arbejdssteder og have kontakt med både kunder og medarbejdere i løbet af arbejdsdagen.

Vi søger en person, som er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og selvstændig. Du skal kunne planlægge din egen arbejdsdag og samtidig bevare overblikket over flere medarbejdere og forskellige kundeopgaver. Det er vigtigt, at du kan tage ansvar og træffe beslutninger i forbindelse med den daglige drift.

Vi forventer desuden, at du har gode samarbejdsevner og kan kommunikere professionelt med både kunder, medarbejdere og virksomhedens ledelse. Du skal kunne håndtere forskellige typer mennesker og situationer og være i stand til at løse problemer på en rolig og professionel måde.

Erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, servicebranchen, personaleledelse, arbejdsplanlægning eller koordinering vil være en fordel. Det er ligeledes en fordel, hvis du tidligere har haft ansvar for medarbejdere eller arbejdet med kvalitetskontrol og kundekontakt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du har en praktisk tilgang til arbejdet og er villig til at tage ansvar for, at opgaverne bliver løst korrekt. Du skal have forståelse for, at kvalitet, stabilitet og god kundeservice er afgørende i rengøringsbranchen.

Hos MB Rengøring ApS tilbyder vi en fast fuldtidsstilling med et stort selvstændigt ansvar og mulighed for at få indflydelse på den daglige drift. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, gode kunderelationer og en professionel arbejdsform.

Du vil få mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens ledelse og være med til at udvikle og forbedre vores interne arbejdsgange, kvalitetsprocedurer og planlægning.

Vi søger en medarbejder, som ønsker et langsigtet samarbejde og som har lyst til at være med til at udvikle MB Rengøring ApS i takt med, at virksomheden får flere kunder og flere medarbejdere.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling, og arbejdet vil primært foregå på forskellige kundeadresser.

Ansøgning med relevante oplysninger om erfaring og tidligere beskæftigelse sendes til MB Rengøring ApS.

title: Creative Lead at NAKED Copenhagen
description:
Join NAKED Copenhagen as our new Creative Lead

Do you see visuals before they exist? Do you know how to turn brand identity into campaigns, designs, content, and experiences that people remember?

Then you might be the Creative Lead we’re looking for at NAKED Copenhagen.

This is not just a design role. It’s a key creative position at the heart of our Marketing & Creative Team, someone who’s shaping how NAKED Copenhagen looks, feels, and communicates across every touchpoint.


About the Role

As our new Creative Lead, you’ll take ownership of our visual direction and help bring our brand universe to life across digital, physical, and social platforms.

Working closely with Stine, our Founder & CEO, you’ll play a key role in translating NAKED Copenhagen’s vision into creative concepts, campaigns, and experiences that resonate with our colleagues, partners, community, and customers.

You’ll collaborate closely with various professionals in the Marketing & Creative Team, as well as E-Commerce, Retail, Buying & Merchandising, and external partners, to develop ideas and execute content that strengthens our brand presence.

From campaign editorials and website experiences to social media, collaborations, and product design, you’ll be a central part of shaping, maintaining, and evolving the NAKED Copenhagen identity.


What You’ll Do

•          Owning and evolving the brand's creative direction and visual identity across all customer touchpoints.

•          Developing creative concepts and leading the visual execution of campaigns, content and brand experiences.

•          Design and deliver exciting, engaging graphics across web pages, newsletters, logos, signs, advertisements, instore window layouts and other communication materials.

•          Leading art direction for photo, video and content productions while ensuring a consistently high creative standard.

•          Overseeing the visual expression across digital platforms, retail, events and all brand communication.

•          Collaborating closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and other key teams to translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions.

•          Leading selected collaborations, special projects and brand activations that strengthen the brand's visual identity and positioning.

 

Who You Are

•          A confident creative thinker with a strong eye for aesthetics, detail, and visual storytelling.

•          5+ years of experience within the fashion and lifestyle industry, with a scope including execution on design processes, graphic design, and campaign development.

•          Experience with developing visual concepts from idea to final execution.

•          Passionate about fashion, sneakers, culture, and contemporary brand building.

•          Comfortable balancing creativity with ambitious commercial goals and deadlines.

•          Able to work independently while collaborating closely with different teams while translating the creative agenda and vision.

•          Structured, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects at once as we always operate with an ambitious marketing calendar.

•          Strong understanding of digital platforms, social media trends, and content creation.

•          Communicate confidently in English, written and spoken.

•          Have experience from a similar creative, design, or brand-focused role.

About the Marketing & Creative Team

You’ll join our Marketing & Creative Team led by Simon, our Buying & Marketing Director. Together, the team shapes and executes everything from campaigns and launches to shoots, social content, events, and brand collaborations.

What We Offer

•          A fast-moving and creative work environment.

•          A role where your ideas directly shape the NAKED Copenhagen brand.

•          Creative ownership and responsibility from day one.

•          Close collaboration with a passionate team across marketing, e-commerce, retail, and buying.

•          Hands-on involvement in campaigns, launches, collaborations, and brand experiences.

•          A workplace where creativity, energy, and teamwork matter.

•          A job that goes beyond the desk.

Interested?

Please send your CV and application in English or Danish to job@nakedcph.com with “Creative Lead” in the subject line.

We’re looking forward to meeting you.

On behalf of,
Simon, Marketing & Creative Department
& the rest of the NAKED Copenhagen Team

title: FAST NATTEVAGT
description:
Fast Nattevagt

FRIT VALG - SVANE PLEJE ApS

Drømmer du om en hverdag der er præget af nærvær og samarbejde? Og er du en natteravn, der med sit store overblik og fødder solidt plantet på jorden kan skabe ro og tryghed for vores borgere som udekørende personale til hjemmeplejen? Så søger vi dig.

Frit Valg Svane Pleje søger social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent til nattevagt i 7/7 rul i hjemmeplejen i vores afdeling i Nørresundby.

Vi har gennem den seneste tid gennemgået en rivende udvikling i vores arbejdsgange i forhold til Implementering af den nye ældrereform – til gavn for kollegaer og borgere. Vi er kommet en lang vej og ønsker at fortsætte den gode udvikling. I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi i teams på tværs af hele døgnet for at styrke samarbejdet kollegaer imellem og skabe den helt rigtige opmærksomhed og sparring på vores borgeres forløb og pleje.

Vi søger en kollega, der kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og yde den bedste pleje til vores borgere. Vi tilbyder en fast stilling til nattevagt, der kører i 7-7 rul med faste vagter med mødetid 23-07 og med vagter hver anden weekend. Arbejdet består primært af pleje og praktisk bistand til vores borgere, og du vil få din egen rute med faste borgere.

Opgaverne er mangeartede, men overordnet kan nævnes:

·         Grundlæggende pleje- og omsorgsopgaver

·         Praktisk og personlig pleje af borgeren, der støtter borgeren i at bevare deres værdighed og skaber livsglæde

·         Observation, test og screening af borgerne med henblik på tidlig opsporing og sygepleje

·         Samarbejde med borgere, kollegaer og eksterne kommunale samarbejdspartner

·         Dokumentation i omsorgssystemet Cura


Du vil blive en del af et team af assistenter, hjælpere og afløsere i overlap med aftenvagterne. Vi arbejder værdibaseret og er motiverede af at have medinddragelse og medindflydelse. Vi har borgeren i centrum og har fokus på at give den enkelte borger mulighed for at leve et værdigt liv med trivsel og livsglæde.

Vil du med på holdet?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet social og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent og som brænder for at arbejde med borgere i eget hjem, der gennem helhjertet og professionel indsats vil gøre en stor forskel for vores borgeres hverdag og trivsel.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at:

·         Du har et kæmpe omsorgsgen og kan lide at arbejde med mennesker

·         Er i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og hviler i sig selv og sin faglighed

·         Du er dygtig til at kommunikere og arbejde tværprofessionelt

·         Du kan skabe tryghed og ro hos borgeren og kollegaer gennem dit overblik

·         Du er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde på egen hånd

Vi kan tilbyde:

·         En fast stilling på 7/7 rul med weekendarbejde hver anden uge

·         Et grundigt introduktionsforløb, hvor du kører sammen med en kollega den første tid og bliver oplært i vores systemer

·         Stor frihed under ansvar

·         Muligheden for kompetenceudvikling og kollegial sparring

·         Synlig og nærværende ledelse, der har fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø og det gode samarbejde

Sammen skaber vi gode rammer for din ansættelse
Dit primære arbejdssted er i Nørresundby, hvor du møder ind og starter din rute. Kørekort B er påkrævet, da vores ruter udelukkende er bilruter. På adressen er der mulighed for at låne en af vores firmabiler, som står til rådighed.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold
Vi ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt. Der indkaldes til samtale løbende.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Jannike Frølund 41 40 20 10 eller aalborg@svanepleje.dk

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

title: Ergoterapeut til Helhedsplejen
description:
Er du en fagligt stærk ergoterapeut med interesse for rehabilitering og genoptræning? Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for ældre borgere – med udgangspunkt i deres egne ønsker og mål? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Frit Valg Svane Pleje Nørresundby.

 

Om os

I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi ud fra ældrelovens værdier om selvbestemmelse, fokus på borgerinddragelse og personcentreret omsorg. Vores tilgang bygger på et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og en helhedsorienteret indsats, hvor borgerens ressourcer og livskvalitet er i centrum.

I Frit Valg Svane Pleje arbejder vi teamorganiseret. Du bliver tilknyttet et eller flere teams bestående af en planlægger, SOSU-assistenter, SOSU-hjælpere og ufaglærte. Du får desuden en fysioterapeut som kollega i afdelingen og du bliver en del af et engageret terapeutteam på tværs af alle vores 14 afdelinger, hvor der er mulighed for sparring.

Om stillingen

Opgaverne som ergoterapeut spænder bredt inden for forebyggelse, vedligeholdelse, rehabilitering og genoptræning. Du skal fungere som forløbsansvarlig hovedsaligt for borgere visiteret efter Ældreloven, herunder afklaring af hjælpsbehov og vurdering af rehabiliteringspotentiale samt planlægning af borgerens forløb efterfølgende.

Du har desuden til opgave at understøtte, at alle SOSU-assistenter, SOSU-hjælpere og ufaglærte arbejder rehabiliterende, hvilket vi forestiller os sker via daglig sparring med kolleger, deltagelse i teammøder og tværfaglige møder, undervisning og supervision. Det er derfor en forudsætning, at du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at varetage en vejledende rolle ift. dine kollegers faglige udvikling.

Du får mulighed for generelt at bidrage i kvalitets- og udviklingsopgaver, f.eks. skal vi implementere velfærdsteknologiske løsninger og styrke samarbejdet med frivillighed og civilsamfund.

En typisk dag starter ude ved borgerne, hvor du fx opstarter et rehabiliteringsforløb, træner at borgeren kan blive selvhjulpen i bad eller til måltid, foretager en arbejdspladsvurdering eller understøtter dine kolleger i hverdagsrehabilitering. Senere har du fx administrative opgaver på kontoret, hvor du bestiller hjælpemidler, udfører dokumentationspraksis og dagen afsluttes måske med et tværfagligt møde.

 

Dine opgaver

  • Som forløbsansvarlig skal du vurdere borgerens rehabiliterings- og genoptræningspotentiale og opstarte den rette hjælp eller træning og sikre løbende opfølgning på forløb

  • Inddrage kolleger i borgerens plan, således alle arbejder med borgernes mål og med afsæt i den rehabiliterende tankegang

  • Varetage aktivitets- eller genoptræning i borgerens hjem eller som holdtræning

  • Sikre faglig refleksion, facilitere tværfaglige møder og teammøder

  • Understøtte tværfagligt samarbejde med kommunale samarbejdspartnere, herunder myndighed

  • Sætte fokus på frivillighed og civilsamfundets betydning for borgerens liv

  • Bidrage til oplæring af nye medarbejdere og understøtte opgavefordeling efter kompetencer

 

Om dig – faglige kompetencer

  • Du arbejder struktureret, reflekteret og med høj faglighed

  • Du formidler tydeligt – både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Du ser stor værdi i tværfagligt samarbejde og kan facilitere møder på tværs

  • Du er motiveret for at dele viden, skabe læring og udvikle kollegers kompetencer

 

Om dig – personlige kompetencer

  • Du trives med alsidige opgaver og en til tider uforudsigelig hverdag

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Du er samarbejdsorienteret og bidrager til et positivt og lærende arbejdsmiljø

  • Du brænder for at støtte borgeren i at nå sine mål og bevare livskvaliteten

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag

  • Mulighed for at påvirke implementeringen af den nye ældrelov og mulighed for at påvirke implementering af den nye sundhedsreform i 2027, hvor genoptræning efter §140 forventes at indgå for private leverandører

  • Mulighed for vidensdeling på tværs af afdelingerne samt Svane Plejes kvalitetsgruppe

  • Kort mellem handling og beslutning

 

Ansøgning og ansættelsesforhold

Der er tale om en fastansættelse på 32-37 timer, hvor du kan være med til at aftale ugentlig arbejdstid ved ansættelse. Arbejdstid planlægges typisk indenfor tidsrummet kl. 7-16, men eftermiddag og/eller aftenarbejde kan forekomme.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat fra 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Ansøgningsfrist den 18/10-2026

Samtaler forventes afholdt uge 43. Der kan indgå en kort case til samtalen.

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller ønsker stillingsopslaget uddybet, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

-          Direktør Tina Jørgensen 41402010 hverdage mellem kl. 08.00 og 14.00 eller på e-mailadressen tij@svanepleje.dk

-          Faglig chef for rehabilitering og genoptræning Trine Bassett på. tlf. 92 43 51 22 eller på e-mail tpi@svanepleje.dk (træffes i uge 31-33)

description:

Fuldtid eller deltid · Opstart efter aftale

Martini House er en italiensk-amerikansk nabolagsrestaurant på Brigadevej i Amager. Vi laver den slags mad, vi selv elsker at spise — generøs, klassisk og ukompliceret — i et rum, der er varmt, livligt og en lille smule old-school.

For os handler god service først og fremmest om værtskab. Vi vil have gæsterne til at føle sig velkomne, godt taget hånd om og have lyst til at komme igen. Det betyder, at vi tager vores arbejde seriøst, men ikke os selv alt for seriøst.

Vi leder efter mennesker med personlighed, som kan læse et bord, arbejde hurtigt, når restauranten er fuld, og stadig få gæsterne til at føle, at de har god tid.

Dine opgaver

• Være opmærksom på hele restauranten — ikke kun dine egne borde

• Hjælpe dine kolleger, når de har travlt, og bidrage til en stærk og generøs servicekultur

• Holde restauranten ren, organiseret og klar til gæster

• Være til stede og engageret på gulvet fra første til sidste bord

Vi leder efter dig, der

• Har erfaring fra restaurant eller hospitality — gerne fra en travl restaurant

• Oprigtigt kan lide at tage sig af mennesker

• Har personlighed og selvtillid uden at gøre service formel eller stiv

• Kan holde hovedet koldt, når restauranten er fuld

• Ser, hvad der skal gøres, uden altid at skulle blive bedt om det

Martini House is an Italian-American neighborhood restaurant on Brigadevej in Amager. We serve the kind of food we love to eat — generous, classic and uncomplicated — in a room that’s warm, lively and a little bit old-school.

What we’re looking for

• Someone who notices what needs doing without always having to be asked

What we offer

title: SOMMERJOB MED HAVUDSIGT
description:
NIXE - ÆRØ - JULI & AUGUST 2027

Færgen tager dig på arbejde. Og når du først er her, må du gerne blive hele sommeren.

Til Nixe, vores lille strand- og havnebar i Ærøskøbing, søger vi ekstra hænder i juli og august. Her mødes øboere, sejlere, sommergæster og folk, der egentlig bare lige skulle kigge forbi til en enkelt øl. Der er kaffe på kajen, kolde drinks, musik under lyskæderne og lange sommeraftener ved havnen.

Din hverdag foregår mest bag baren: Du laver kaffe og drinks, betjener vores gæster, tager imod betaling og hjælper med at holde det hele kørende. Glas, opvask og oprydning hører selvfølgelig også med. Har du barista-erfaring, er det et plus – og vi bager også pizza her. Når solen skinner, og havnen er fuld, kan der godt komme fart på.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du kan lide mennesker, tager fat, hvor der er brug for det, og stadig kan smile, når der pludselig står ti mennesker i kø. Erfaring fra bar, café eller service er dejligt, men god energi, pålidelighed og lyst til at være en del af holdet betyder mindst lige så meget for os.

Måske studerer du. Måske holder du lige en pause fra et eller andet. Måske har du bare lyst til at bruge en sommer på en dansk ø. Uanset hvad vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Skriv lidt om dig selv, hvad du har lavet før, og om du kan være her i juli og august.

Som det ser ud lige nu, kan vi desværre ikke tilbyde bolig, men vi hjælper gerne med at finde noget. De fleste vagter ligger mellem kl. 13.00 og 20.00.

title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Restaurationsmanager
description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

•    Permanent, year-round employment
