You have experience in embedded software development and can translate technical needs into robust, efficient, and maintainable software solutions.



Qualifications:

University degree within software engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

A few years of experience in low level embedded software development. Experience within motor control and battery systems is a strong plus. Also knowledge in safety standards and cyber security (CRA etc.).

    Good knowledge of C, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Git, and serial communication.
    Fluent in English, both spoken and written.
    Experience from Jira, C++/C#



Location

Our team is based in Huskvarna.



How we work

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.



Application

Does this sound interesting? Don't hesitate to apply as soon as possible, as we apply ongoing selection. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For more information about the position please contact Hiring Manager Joakim Wibring, Manager Software at Joakim.Wibring@husqvarnagroup.com.

For questions regarding the recruitment process please contact Talent Acquisition partner – Katarina Engberg at katarina.engberg@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters. Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

title: Lagermedarbetare till Bromma-Stockholm
description:
Är du noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och en god lagspelare? Då kan du komma långt hos oss på WeStaff Sweden! Vi söker nu en noggrann och pålitlig lagermedarbetare till vår kund i Norra Stockholm.

Om tjänsten Vi söker nu dig som vill arbeta i en lager- och logistiknära roll hos ett industriföretag i Norra Stockholm (Bromma). Tjänsten har fokus på truckkörning, orderplock, packning och hantering av varuflödet inför in/utleverans.

I rollen arbetar du med att ta emot färdiga produkter från produktion, kontrollera dem enligt plocklistor och instruktioner samt säkerställa att godset är korrekt emballerat och redo för leverans. I rollen är noggrannhet, kvalitet, struktur och effektivitet avgörande.

Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat lagerteam där samarbete, ansvar och noggrannhet bidrar till att leveranser sker i rätt tid och med rätt kvalitet.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    

Truckkörning (motviktstruck, ledstaplare)

    

Orderplock både för hand och med truck

    

Paketering och emballering enligt plocklistor

    

Kontroll av produkter mot synliga avvikelser såsom repor och skador

    

Transport av färdigemballerade produkter till utleverans med truck

    

Säkerställa ordning och kvalitet i emballeringsprocessen

    

Följa rutiner och instruktioner för arbetsmiljö och kvalitet

Vem är du?

Du trivs i en praktisk lagerroll och gillar att arbeta strukturerat med tydliga rutiner. Du är ansvarstagande, noggrann och har förståelse för hur kvalitet och tempo påverkar hela leveranskedjan. Du arbetar bra både självständigt och i team och bidrar till en god laganda. I övrigt trivs du med ett fysiskt arbete.

Krav

    

Erfarenhet av lager, produktion, paketering eller motsvarande

    

Truckkort (motviktstruck och ledstaplare, meriterande med fler truckbehörigheter)

    

Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande

    

Erfarenhet av arbete inom industri eller produktion

    

Vana av kvalitetskontroller eller arbete med större produkter

Övrigt Start: Omgående. Omfattning: Heltid Arbetstid: Dagtid måndag-fredag (ca 7-16) Plats: Bromma-Stockholm.

Upplägg: Långsiktigt arbete

Ansökan

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan! Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Observera att vi tyvärr inte kan ta emot ansökningar via e-post.

Om WeStaff Sweden

WeStaff Sweden är ett auktoriserat bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med uppdrag över hela Sverige. Vi arbetar nära både kunder och kandidater för att skapa långsiktiga och trygga matchningar.

Som anställd hos oss erbjuds du en trygg anställning med kollektivavtal, försäkringar och ett närvarande engagemang. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och kvalitet – varje dag. Vill du bli en av oss? Ansök nu och bli vår nästa medarbetare. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

title: Operatör
description:
Inom Rock Tools i Sandviken tillverkar vi borrverktyg för affärsområde Mining. Vill du arbeta med modern tillverkning där säkerhet, kvalitet och lagarbete står i centrum? Till vår produktion av borrkronor inom topphammarprodukter söker vi en nyfiken och ansvarstagande operatör som vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Om jobbet

Som operatör arbetar du med tillverkning av borrverktyg i en högautomatiserad produktionsmiljö. Tillsammans med dina kollegor bidrar du till produkter av hög kvalitet, samtidigt som säkerheten alltid kommer först.



Arbetet är förlagt till skift.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Tillverka borrkronor inom segmentet topphammarprodukter.
    Arbeta säkert och följa gällande kvalitetskrav.

Om dig

title: Butiksmedarbetare Byggmax Arvika, 20%
description:
Vill du hjälpa människor förverkliga sina drömmar? Byggmax affärsidé är att sälja byggmaterial av hög kvalitet till lägsta möjliga pris för att på så vis ge människor råd och möjlighet att förverkliga sina byggdrömmar. Vi erbjuder dig en möjlighet att bidra på vår resa mot att bli världens bästa byggvaruhandel!

Alla medarbetare utför samtliga arbetsuppgifter på våra anläggningar, vilket gör arbetet väldigt roligt och varierande. En arbetsdag kan bland annat innehålla kundservice, prismärkning, inventering, samt mottagande och uppackning av varor. Du kommer arbeta i en snabbrörlig och föränderlig organisation med trevliga kollegor och en stark företagskultur!

På Byggmax jobbar vi med friskvård och för att ha en god balans i livet. Vi hittar på roliga teamaktiviteter ihop för att stärka gruppen och hos oss finns det alltid möjlighet för utveckling.

Som butikssäljare är dina viktigaste uppgifter att:

    Arbeta aktivt med kundbemötandet – vi vill ge alla kunder en förstklassig service.
    Sälja högkvalitativa byggvaror till marknadens bästa pris.
    Hålla ordning och reda i lokalerna och se till att hyllorna alltid är välfyllda.
    Plocka virke, inventera, hantera inleveranser och prismärka varor för att säkerställa att kundens upplevelse blir positiv
    Hjälpa till att mäta och räkna kundernas varor

Kvalifikationer:

    Ha ett intresse av renovering och bygg, detaljhandel och kundbemötande
    Drivs av försäljning och att överträffa kundens förväntningar
    Kunna räkna och mäta kundernas varor obehindrat
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska och kan göra sig förstådd på engelska
    Tillgänglig att arbeta under anläggningens öppettider
    Kan stå för och arbeta efter våra värderingar

Önskvärda personliga egenskaper:

    Serviceinriktad – har en vilja att arbeta med service och brinner för att arbeta med försäljning
    Snabb, effektiv, lyhörd, flexibel – egenskaper som kan ge en god kundupplevelse
    Ansvarstagande - för egen utveckling och för anläggningens framgång – inställningen laget före jaget
    Har driv och engagemang för anläggningen
    Kan arbeta självständigt och är självgående
    Är van att ta egna initiativ och ser vad som behöver göras
    Nyfiken på att lära sig nya saker

Övrigt:

    Erfarenhet av bygg, detaljhandel och kundbemötande är meriterande
    Önskvärt med B-körkort eller truckkort
    Truckvana är meriterande
    Truckutbildning och körtillstånd ges internt på anläggningen, om du är över 18 år och innehar B-körkort eller truckkort sedan tidigare.

Arbetstider:

    Enligt anläggningens öppettider, inklusive tidig morgon, kvällar och helger.
    Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning med start från 2026-10-12 och slut 2026-12-31.

Byggmax präglas av en stark företagskultur där respekt och trivsel på jobbet är viktiga ingredienser och där varje individ förväntas bidra. Vi värdesätter dina personliga egenskaper framför erfarenhet och ser gärna att du är snabb, effektiv och lyhörd på samma gång – egenskaper som kan ge en god kundupplevelse. Det du inte redan har kunskap kring, har vi utbildningar för. Vi har en väldigt stark företagskultur med mycket glädje och starkt samarbete i grunden och vi söker dig som vill vara en del av detta. För att matcha oss är du redo att ta ansvar för både din utveckling och för anläggningens framgång, med inställningen laget före jaget.

Vi värdesätter mångfald och välkomnar alla sökande, vår rekryteringsprocess är därför byggd för att ge oss en objektivitet. Känner du att detta är rätt utmaning för dig? Tveka inte att ansöka om tjänsten! Urvalet sker löpande, skicka därför din ansökan redan idag.

Alla hemmasnickare ska kunna förverkliga sina byggdrömmar, det tycker i alla fall vi på Byggmax. Oavsett om det handlar om inomhus-, utomhus- eller trädgårdsprojekt. Därför jobbar alla Byggmaxare mot samma mål: att ge dessa hemmasnickare både råd och möjlighet till det!

Byggmax har totalt över 190 butiker fördelat i Sverige, Norge, Danmark och Finland. Utöver de fysiska butikerna finns även en ständigt växande e-handel. Sedan starten 1993 har Byggmax haft som affärsidé att vara det bästa och billigaste alternativet för hobbysnickare och proffs som vill köpa byggmaterial av bra kvalitet. Vi har gått från att vara en ettrig uppstickare till att bli en av Sveriges största byggmaterialkedjor. Med hjälp av ständiga förbättringar, löpande effektiviseringar och en förändringsbenägen företagskultur har bolaget blivit ett av branschens lönsammaste. I koncernen Byggmax Group ingår även Skånska Byggvaror, Buildor, Right Price Tiles och Næstved Lavpristræ.

Varmt välkommen till Byggmax, både som kund och som potentiell medarbetare!

title: Kafka Platform Engineer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help build and run a shared integration platform that multiple development teams depend on for reliable, secure, and scalable data flows. This role sits close to the core platform, with a strong focus on Apache Kafka, HiveMQ, Kubernetes, automation, and end-to-end operational ownership. You will work across platform stability, self-service, observability, and continuous improvement, and support project teams when deeper integration expertise is needed.

You will collaborate with security, architecture, and development teams in a complex technical environment where resilience, performance, and governance matter. This is a great role for you if you enjoy owning business-critical platform capabilities and influencing how developers use them safely and efficiently.

Job Description

    You will design, deploy, and operate multi-cluster, multi-region Apache Kafka environments with Strimzi on Kubernetes, as well as HiveMQ brokers.
    You will drive platform upgrades for Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ, and help keep the platform secure and stable with minimal disruption.
    You will develop and maintain custom Kafka connectors to move data between legacy systems and cloud environments.
    You will shape scaling strategies, topology rules, storage setup, and resource allocation for message-heavy workloads.
    You will manage partition layouts, topic compaction, retention settings, and overall cluster performance.
    You will design high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including cross-region replication and automated failover.
    You will implement governance and security controls around schemas, ACLs, SASL, OAuth/OIDC paths, mTLS, SSL, and RBAC.
    You will build observability and alerting with Prometheus and Grafana, and define proactive monitoring for platform health.
    You will perform root cause analysis, improve platform guardrails, and provide Tier 3 support for complex integration issues.
    You will guide application teams working with Java and Spring Boot on producer and consumer settings, schema handling, and platform best practices.
    You will build reusable CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions and work with Helm and KEDA to strengthen automation and self-service.

Requirements

    At least 4 years of experience with Apache Kafka, Strimzi, Kafka Connect API, and Kraft.
    At least 4 years of experience working with Java and Spring Boot.
    Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
    Experience with PostgreSQL.
    Experience with Linux, including WSL.
    Experience with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.
    Experience with CI/CD using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins.
    Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform or equivalent.
    Knowledge of Splunk, Fluent Bit, Helm, Grafana, and Prometheus.
    Experience with Apache Kafka at platform level, including clusters, performance, and security.
    Experience with HiveMQ broker.
    Fluent English, spoken and written.
    You are comfortable with end-to-end operational responsibility.

Nice to have

    Experience with APIM platforms.
    Broader cloud experience across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
    Experience with cloud cost optimization.
    Experience from integration departments in large enterprise environments.
    Swedish language skills are a plus.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Logistic specialist
description:
Logistics Specialist Road & Rail

At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.

We are looking for two Logistics Specialists with a passion for transportation, planning, and stakeholder collaboration to join our Logistics Team Road & Rail. Does that sound like you?

About the job

Join a dynamic logistics team where no two days are alike. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring efficient and cost-effective transportation operations while collaborating with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

This is a parental leave coverage role for 6 months on a fulltime basis.

In your future role as Logistics Specialist you will

    Plan, execute, monitor, and report road transportation activities in line with service and cost targets.
    Coordinate shipments and manage transportation exceptions, including re-routing, re-planning, and stakeholder communication.
    Ensure smooth cooperation between carriers, customer service, sales, business planning, and site logistics teams.
    Support carrier invoice handling, payment follow-up, and surcharge management.
    Work daily in transport management systems (TMS) to manage and optimize logistics flows.
    Drive continuous improvements together with logistics providers by following up on KPIs and transportation performance.

We believe you bring

    A Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
    Experience working with logistics or supply chain operations.
    Knowledge of transportation planning, execution, and logistics processes.
    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to quickly identify and implement solutions.
    Good understanding of the transportation and logistics market.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Great if you have

    Experience working within the chemical industry.
    Knowledge of logistics-related systems such as SAP, TMS, or WMS.
    Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and other business management tools.

We believe you are

You are proactive and take ownership of your work, ensuring that tasks are completed efficiently and accurately. You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy building strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. You are structured and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service. As logistics environments can change rapidly, you are adaptable and comfortable making decisions in a dynamic setting.



We offer you

You will join an experienced and engaged logistics team where collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work. This role offers a broad network of internal and external contacts and the opportunity to contribute to the development of logistics processes and transportation performance. At Nouryon, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to a more sustainable future through safe and efficient supply chain operations.



Have we got your interest?  

This is a parental leave coverage role for 6 months on a full-time basis, reporting to Frida Teike, Supervisor Rail & Road and based in Gamlestan at our Nordic Business Center..

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job description

This is a recruitment:

We are Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. By combining physical clinics with a modern digital platform, we serve millions of consultations every year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team operates with startup autonomy inside a profitable, international. We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast. AI is a real working tool here, not a buzzword. We use it daily, we expect you to as well, and we hire people who treat it as a force multiplier.

What You'll Do

Our data platform works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We have data scattered across Postgres databases, Amplitude, S3 file dumps, and a tangle of Python jobs that move it around. The reports get built and the business runs on them, but trust is brittle, reconciliation is too manual, and the foundations need work before we can scale to where we're going.

We need someone who can help us rebuild this, not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where the warehouse is clean and the pipelines just run, this isn't it. If you want to redesign a data platform from the foundations up, with real ownership and the leverage to make it good, here is what you will own:

    Reshape the data foundations: Drive multi-tenancy, retention policies, and data contracts with backend services.
    Decide the future warehouse: Determine what the warehouse actually should be: self-hosted Postgres + dbt, managed Snowflake or BigQuery, or something else. You will shape this direction.
    Unify disparate data sources: Connect three main data streams that don't currently talk to each other: our operational databases, Amplitude product analytics, and a long tail of S3-based partner integrations.
    Build platform observability: Implement data lineage, freshness checks, and alerting that delivers actionable value.
    Own core business reporting: Own the reports that finance, operations, and the board rely on. Make those reports trustworthy by design, not through manual reconciliation.
    Work directly with domain teams: Collaborate closely with backend, product, and finance teams. You're not a service desk, you're a peer shaping how data gets produced upstream, not just consumed downstream.
    Leverage AI aggressively: Use AI for pipeline boilerplate, schema generation, transformation logic, and exploratory analysis, maintaining the same engineering discipline we hold ourselves to.

You will be part of a small data engineering team. That means a lot of ownership and direct impact without layers of management.



Responsibilities

Tech Stack

    Sources: Postgres (operational), Amplitude (events), S3 (integrations and dumps)
    Languages: Python, SQL
    Cloud: AWS (multi-account)
    Warehouse: Postgres today, an open question for tomorrow
    Transformation: Likely dbt going forward
    Orchestration: Open question, you will help shape this
    AI: Claude and OpenAI integrated into daily workflows




Qualifications

What We're Looking For

    Data Platform Experience: You've designed and run data platforms in production, not just written DAGs. You have strong views on build vs. buy, where transformations belong, and how to keep schemas honest as products evolve.
    Core Technical Stack: You're fluent in Python and SQL, with clear opinions on how Postgres should (and shouldn't) be used as a warehouse.
    Data Modeling & dbt: You've used dbt or an equivalent tool in a production environment and understand data modeling principles (staging, marts, testing).
    Managed Warehouses: You have working knowledge of one or more managed warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and can evaluate them objectively against self-hosted options.
    Orchestration: You're comfortable with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, etc.) and understand what an orchestrator is built to achieve.
    Data Contracts: You think about data contracts as a product problem rather than just a pipeline problem and can effectively communicate that perspective to backend engineers.
    Active AI Usage: You use AI in your daily workflow and can talk specifically about how you leverage it.
    Healthcare & Regulations (Plus): Healthcare data experience and familiarity with Patientdatalagen are a plus. GDPR fluency is expected.
    Education: Relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience.

Swedish citizenship requirement




About the company



Randstad

På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential.

Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

title: Position as a Diplomate in Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia, SLU
description:
Department of Clinical Sciences

The University Animal Hospital (UDS) at the Department of Clinical Sciences (KV), serves as SLU's centre for clinical research and education. At UDS, veterinary students, veterinarians, and veterinary nurses receive hands-on training, while clinical research is actively conducted. The management team promotes a forward-thinking and supportive environment, encouraging employees to develop their skills and pursue their interests through ongoing professional development. Benefits include a wellness allowance and a standard 39-hour work week.

We are now seeking a Specialist in Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia with broad experience in small animal practise. Welcome with your application!

About the position

Your primary responsibilities will include responsibility for patients and patient safety in the daily clinical work and supervising students in anaesthesia and analgesia within the university clinics. Participation in the out-of-hours service is also expected.

In your day-to-day role, you will be actively involved in the clinical teaching of veterinary students, interns, and residents. You will also provide guidance and support to veterinary nurses.

Opportunities to engage in ongoing clinical research are available, and you may also contribute to lecturing, small group teaching, and assessing veterinary students. A crucial aspect of your work will involve advising and collaborating with veterinarians in other disciplines, such as intensive care and in patient care. Regular consultations with veterinarians, including referral veterinarians, are an integral part of this role.

Your profile

You are a licensed Veterinarian eligible to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden, and a EBVS® European Veterinary Specialist in Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia or an ACVAA board-certified specialist.

Teaching and/or research experience in the field is considered merits.

Proficiency in English is required, and you either speak a Scandinavian language or are committed to learning Swedish within a time-period of ca 2-3 years.

Significant emphasis will be placed on personal qualities. We value a professional approach and expect you to be flexible, appreciate teamwork, and contribute to the smooth operation of the surgical department.

About us

The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities within all these fields encompass all animal species.

At the SLU University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate tomorrow’s veterinarians and veterinary nurses and provide first-class care for companion animals, competition animals and production animals. We also share knowledge with the general public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are developing the veterinary care of the future.

Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern, purpose-built facilities, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging and a specialist veterinary laboratory.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Permanent employment. SLU may use 6 months probationary employment.

100%

As agreed.

title: Material Impact Analyst
description:
Material Impact Analyst

Company Description

As IKEA continues to grow, our ambition is to reach more customers while maintaining low prices and strengthening our position as the leader in affordable life at home. To achieve this, IKEA is accelerating key strategic priorities including affordability, material transformation, circularity, and smarter ways of working through trusted data and insights.

In Purchasing Development, our assignment goes hand in hand with the IKEA Business Idea as we are responsible for producing a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. Together with our suppliers, we produce IKEA products with affordability, accessibility, sustainability, and quality as our main priorities.

Material transformation is one of IKEA's key strategic focus areas. As we increase the use of renewable, recycled, and innovative materials while reducing the environmental footprint of our products, understanding the impacts of materials and supply chains becomes increasingly important. We want to identify opportunities, evaluate emerging material solutions, and support the transition towards more sustainable affordable products. And that is where you, together with the Material Impact Assessment team, come in!

Job Description

As a Material Impact Analyst, you will help IKEA understand and reduce the environmental impacts of materials, products, and supply chains. By combining scientific analysis with business understanding, you will provide the data, insights, and recommendations needed to support material innovation, product development, sourcing decisions, and long-term sustainability goals.

Your assignment is to:

    Conduct Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), material impact assessments, and develop emission factors to help IKEA understand and reduce the environmental footprint of materials, products, and supply chains.
    Provide environmental expertise to material transformation and sustainability initiatives, including a focus on emerging topics such as biogenic carbon, recycled and renewable materials, land use, and carbon capture utilisation (CCU).
    Develop and maintain IKEA's environmental footprint data assets, including assurance-ready emission factors and LCA datasets, while collaborating with suppliers, data owners, and stakeholders to improve data quality, coverage, and representativeness.
    Contribute to the development of environmental impact methodologies, reporting, and impact claims, to support credible, transparent, and fit-for-purpose environmental information for business decision-making and external communication.
    Provide subject-matter expertise, training, and decision support to internal stakeholders and external partners, enabling fact-based decisions on materials, innovation priorities, and decarbonisation pathways.

You will report to the Material Impact Manager in Purchasing Development, Core Business Supply.

Qualifications

This role is critical to building and maintaining IKEA's internal capability to assess and improve the environmental performance of materials and products. Beyond delivering LCAs, you will contribute through supplier engagement, methodology development, environmental data management, environmental claims review, and strategic support for business decisions.

You will work closely with stakeholders across sustainability, materials, product development, sourcing, engineering, supply chain, climate, quality, and data management functions. Collaboration with colleagues and partners across multiple countries and business areas will be a natural part of your everyday work.

We are looking for someone who is collaborative, curious, and self-driven, with a strong ability to build trust and work effectively across functions, disciplines, and countries. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and can translate complex environmental insights into clear and actionable recommendations. You are motivated by continuous learning and improvement and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex sustainability challenges.

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have:

    A master’s degree in environmental engineering, Industrial Ecology, Material Science, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
    Minimum 2 years of experience independently conducting detailed Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), from scoping to communication of results.
    Strong knowledge of LCA methodology and environmental assessment standards, including ISO 14040/14044, Product Environmental Footprint (PEF), EN 15804, GHG Protocol, and related frameworks.
    Experience assessing and interpreting environmental impacts, including climate change, biodiversity, water use and resource use and understanding how these impact categories can support business decision-making.
    Experience developing and applying emission factors, environmental datasets, and impact models, with an understanding of data quality, representativeness, uncertainty, and assurance requirements.
    Hands-on experience with LCA tools and databases such as SimaPro, OpenLCA, ecoinvent, or equivalent platforms.
    Knowledge of materials and their environmental impacts, including emerging topics such as circularity, recycled and renewable materials and biogenic carbon.
    The ability to translate complex environmental analyses into clear insights and recommendations that support material strategies, innovation, sustainability initiatives, and business decisions.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across functions in a global and matrixed environment
    A scientific, analytical, and curious mindset, balanced with the pragmatism needed to deliver actionable results.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Additional information

This is a permanent position based in Älmhult, Sweden. We are looking for 2 positions. Please send us your application – CV and letter of motivation – in English latest by 12 October 2026.

title: Nature Guide / Northern Light Guide in Swedish Lapland, November to April
description:
Luleå Travel is an incoming travel agency and all-season activity supplier located in Luleå - Swedish Lapland. We offer attractive winter and summer programs presenting the highlights of Swedish Lapland. Since the start, our focus has been small groups and a personal experience.

We offer a large variety of tours out in the nature around Luleå such as snowshoe walking, ice fishing and of course a hunt for northern lights which is the highlight and dream for many of our guests. Why don’t you join us?

About the job

As a guide at Luleå Travel, you will get to work with guests from all over the world who are here on their dream holiday. Our focus is to offer small groups a personal service and a genuine experience of Luleå and Swedish Lapland.

Luleå Travel is now looking for Nature Guide(s) to strengthen our team during the winter season, from November to April. The open positions are 1 x full time (32-40h/week) and 4 x part time (5-20 h/week or upon agreement). Your working schedule will include both weekday, weekend and evening shift. Relevant training is scheduled early November in Luleå.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for dedicated people with a great interest in nature and outdoor life and who want to share their experiences with our guests. The job as a guide is very varied where the weather and conditions change from day to day, therefore its important you can adapt to rapid changes.

Our guides are the ones who spend the most time with our guests and make sure they have the right equipment for our tours. Here we place great emphasis on social skills and safety thinking. As a guide, you are responsible for preparing the tour, making sure to have the right things with you and being out in good time for your tasks.

Your main tasks will be:

1)      Guide and entertain our guest(s) by minibus or touring bus while seeking the best vantage spot for the Northern Lights. Northern Light tours, both with minibus or on snowshoes, will be the main activity for part time guides.

2)      Guide our guest(s) while ice fishing, by snowshoes, foot or fatbike among ancient forests, while presenting information about its natural history.

3)      Advise our guest(s) in nature photography, especially during the Northern Light Tours.

4)      Transport, entertain and guide our guest(s) between their accommodation and booked activity.

5)      MICE guiding.

Qualifications:

1)      Loves the outdoors and is a natural storyteller.

2)      Winter guiding experience in nature tourism, preferable in Swedish Lapland.

3)      Guide education, international wilderness guide school or similar.

4)      A flexible mindset.

5)      Has an excellent understanding of Swedish Lapland’s natural history and a good knowledge about the phenomena Northern Light.

6)      On ease with capturing both (digital) photos and videos.

7)      First aid training.

8)      Holds a class B driving licence and is comfortable with driving in winter conditions.

9)      Fluent in English + another language.

10)  Can make a fire in all weather conditions.

11)  Knows how to boil Swedish coffee and create a cosy atmosphere.

How to apply?

What is most important to us is the right attitude and social skills, so if you think you are the one we are looking for, do not hesitate to contact us by sending us your CV and a personal letter to cecilia@luleatravel.com or give Cecilia a call at +46 70 620 1901.

title: Site Quality Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Site Quality Manager for a construction and installation project.

This is a consulting assignment. The location is Kiruna, Sweden.

The position is full-time.

The assignment involves close collaboration with the client, requiring a high degree of flexibility and strong collaboration skills.

The Assignment

As Site Quality Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and following up quality management activities at site. The role includes ensuring that quality processes, inspections, documentation, and corrective actions are carried out in accordance with the contract and agreed project procedures.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Establishing and maintaining project-specific Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for site activities and ensuring compliance with contractual requirements.

    

Following up the quality inspection process and ensuring that responsible supervisors and installation teams perform their own inspections and basic inspections according to agreed plans and procedures.

    

Coordinating third-party inspections, including NDT inspections, and ensuring appropriate actions are taken when deviations are identified.

    

Coordinating and arranging inspections together with the client, including witness points and hold points as specified in the contract.

    

Participating in weekly and site meetings and reporting on quality management progress across the different site areas.

    

Using Dalux for documentation management and quality tracking.

    

Organising and following up activities according to the project's daily management model.

    

Identifying and managing deviations and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

    

Performing root cause analysis and implementing actions to minimise the risk of recurring non-conformities.

    

Preparing and delivering quality documentation and reports to the client as agreed.

    

Ensuring that subcontractors understand and comply with the project's quality management requirements.

    

Introducing and reviewing scope-specific ITPs together with responsible supervisors, foremen, and subcontractors.

    

Managing the handover documentation process and ensuring that required documentation is collected and submitted to the client correctly and on time.

    

Collaborating with the Project Manager and the wider project team regarding quality and risk management.

    

Coaching and supporting site management, installation teams, and subcontractors in quality-related matters.

    

Organising site meetings and reporting on quality activities and progress.

Requirements

We are looking for a candidate with relevant education and professional experience suitable for the role.

You should have relevant experience in areas such as:

    

Quality management and quality follow-up in construction and/or installation projects.

    

Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).

    

Quality inspections and inspection processes.

    

Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and deviation management.

    

Root cause analysis.

    

Third-party inspections and NDT inspections.

    

Witness points and hold points.

    

Quality management and follow-up of subcontractors.

    

Handover documentation and document management.

    

Quality and risk management.

    

Digital quality and documentation management systems, preferably Dalux.

    

Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

You are structured, quality-focused, and communicative, with the ability to coordinate quality activities between several stakeholders. You are comfortable working closely with project management, site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and the client.

If this assignment sounds interesting and matches your experience, we look forward to receiving your application and CV.

About Us

Centio’s overall goal is to be a consulting company that provides smart and sustainable solutions that contribute positively to the development of society.

We offer our employees individually tailored working conditions. This means that working hours, workload, workplace, and professional development are, as far as possible, adapted to each employee’s individual needs.

Our team consists of dedicated professionals who are passionate about contributing to the development of society. We work in small teams where you have the opportunity to contribute your own experience while also benefiting from the knowledge and expertise of others.

Employee well-being and maintaining a healthy work-life balance are important to us. We therefore have a zero-vision for work-related stress and place well-being and health at the forefront.

You can read more about us at centio.se.

Please submit your CV in Swedish.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Health, Safety & Environmental Lead
description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We will participate in a project where Stegra  (H2 Green Steel) establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden, where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ a Health, Safety & Environmental Lead. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

JOB DESCRIPTION

The HSE Lead will support the HSE Manager in the implementation and coordination of Health, Safety and Environmental requirements across the project and provide day-to-day leadership and coordination to the site HSE team.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate and supervise the daily activities of HSE Officers and site HSE personnel.

- Monitor site activities and ensure compliance with project HSE requirements, procedures and applicable regulations.

- Conduct and coordinate site inspections, safety walks and follow-up of identified corrective actions.

- Support the review and implementation of Risk Assessments, Method Statements (RAMS), Permit to Work (PTW) and other HSE documentation.

- Provide practical HSE guidance and support to construction management, engineers, supervisors, foremen and subcontractors.

- Monitor high-risk construction activities including lifting operations, work at height, confined space, hot work and other critical activities.

- Lead or support incident and near-miss investigations and follow up corrective and preventive actions.

- Coordinate toolbox talks, HSE inductions, awareness activities and other site safety training.

- Support HSE audits, inspections, reporting, statistics and performance monitoring.

- Participate in emergency preparedness activities and drills.

- Promote a proactive safety culture and intervene when unsafe conditions or practices are identified.

- Report significant HSE risks, observations and site issues to the HSE Manager and support continuous improvement of project HSE performance.

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

- University degree in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety or a related technical field.

- Minimum 7 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably in construction, industrial, energy, oil & gas or similar major projects.

- Previous experience in a Senior HSE, HSE Lead, HSE Chief, HSE Supervisor or HSE Management role.

- Strong practical knowledge of construction HSE, risk assessment, RAMS, PTW, incident investigation and site inspections.

- Experience supervising HSE personnel and working with subcontractors and construction teams.

- NEBOSH IGC or equivalent internationally recognized HSE qualification is preferred.

- Ability to communicate in English in a construction site environment.

- Strong site coordination, leadership and interpersonal skills.

- Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

- Experience in international and multicultural project environments is preferred.

- Knowledge of Swedish construction HSE requirements and/or BAS-P/BAS-U is considered an advantage.

- Willingness and ability to be based in Boden, Sweden for the project duration.

title: SAP Solution Architect
description:
Join us in shaping the future of manufacturing technology at Nobia Park!

Do you want to help shape the digital architecture of one of Europe's most automated and sustainable kitchen manufacturing facilities? Our state-of-the-art facility spans 123,000 m², is BREEAM-certified, and features AGVs, ABB robots, and a 2 MW solar power plant. More than just an advanced manufacturing site, Nobia Park is the key part of our digital transformation journey.

We are now looking for a Solution Architect to help drive that journey by designing and governing the solutions that connect our manufacturing, supply chain, and business operations. As new technologies, automation capabilities, and systems continue to be introduced, you will play a key role in ensuring a scalable, connected, and future-ready digital landscape.

About the role

In this role you will help connect our SAP S/4HANA landscape, manufacturing execution systems (MES), and production operations. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners, you will contribute to strategic development initiatives and the continuous improvement of our digital ecosystem.

Key responsibilities include:

Solution Design & Architecture

    

Design robust, scalable, and secure solutions across SAP and MES environments.

    

Translate business and process requirements into high-level solution designs and architecture.

    

Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles and Nobia's digital strategy.

Stakeholder Collaboration

    

Collaborate with business stakeholders, process owners and end users to understand needs and identify improvement opportunities.

    

Work closely with solution engineers, architects and product owners to deliver integrated solutions and support future roadmaps.

    

Ensure alignment across systems, domains and business functions.

Governance & Compliance

    

Ensure solutions meet architectural, security, compliance, and governance standards.

    

Contribute to architectural reviews, change management processes, and technical decision-making.

    

Maintain clear documentation and traceability throughout the solution lifecycle.

Continuous Improvement

    

Stay up to date with emerging technologies and best practices within SAP, MES, and manufacturing technology.

    

Drive modernization, automation, and system integration initiatives across the manufacturing environment.

    

Identify and remove bottlenecks that impact operational efficiency and order fulfillment.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping, with an expected on-site presence of at least three days per week. The role includes regular travel to other Nobia locations.

Who you are

To succeed in this role, you are a skilled and proactive Solution Architect who combines a holistic perspective with a strong technical understanding. You can navigate complex environments and turn business needs into practical, long-term solutions.

Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you enjoy building relationships across different functions and levels of the organization. With a structured and analytical mindset, you thrive in environments where continuous improvement, innovation, and cross-functional teamwork are key to success. 

We believe you bring:

    

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

    

5+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, with a strong focus on SAP Supply chain management and MES integration.

    

Proven experience in designing and deploying solutions in manufacturing environments.

    

Solid understanding of SAP modules (e.g., PP, MM, QM) and interfaces to MES platforms.

    

Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

    

Ability to balance technical depth with business context in discussions. Preferred Skills:

    

Familiarity with common MES platforms

    

Deep technical knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, particularly within configured products and highly automated make-to-order (MTO) environments.

    

Experience with industrial IoT, edge computing, or data lakes is advantageous.

    

Knowledge of agile methodologies and product-centric delivery models.

    

Certifications such as TOGAF, SAP Certified Technology Associate, or similar are a plus.

About Nobia

Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist, with strong brands such as Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. With us, you will become part of a modern organization where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. We offer excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park – Jönköping. 

Want to be a part of our journey?

Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

If you have any questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Josephine Tjernlund (josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com). We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Production and quality control specialist - Sensors
description:
To strengthen our sensor production team, Biolin Scientific is now looking for a production and quality control specialist. The position is located at our head office in Gothenburg, Sweden.

About us

Biolin Scientific is a world-leading analytical instrument provider with more than30 years of experience in surface & interface analysis. Our technologies are well established and trusted as proven by more than 15,000 scientific journal citations.

We provide research analytical tools and equipment to explore material properties and interactions with precision and reliability, empowering innovation and development, in industry, as well as in academy. Biolin Scientific is part of AddLife - a Swedish Labtech and Medtech company.

Your role and key responsibilities:

As a production and quality control specialist, you will be an integral part of the Biolin Scientific Sensor Team. You will have a key role in the daily in-house sensor production using state-of-the-art thin film deposition techniques like sputtering, spin coating and other deposition techniques. You will also perform quality control on produced sensors using Quartz Crystal Microbalance with Dissipation (QCM-D) technique. Other tasks will include packing and shipping of produced goods. Moreover, you will be responsible for production documentation, QC outcomes and take part in the production and shipping process.  

As a production specialist and quality controller, you will:

    Collect materials and run sensor production as per sensor production daily/weekly plan.
    Perform QC- inspection, and document outcomes and observations in Quality Management System.
    Packing, labeling, storing and shipping goods according to set procedures.
    Meet planned production/delivery deadlines and secure product stock at defined inventory level.
    Keep production and QC equipment, area clean and organized.
    Keep packing and shipping material in an orderly manner to provide for a frictionless shipping process.
    Actively take part in product continuous improvement.

Requirements:

    Documented work experience in a production and QC environment.
    High school diploma or equivalent education preferable within in the field of chemistry, engineering or science.
    Excellent English writing and communications skills.
    Experience of working with quality management system such as (ISO 9001) and production planning system (Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)) would be considered as highly advantageous.
    Knowledge and experience of thin-film deposition technology and materials development would be considered a strong merit.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
    A well organised person with a solid can-do attitude accompanied with a curious mindset.
    Valid work permission to work in Sweden (Company will not sponsor work-visa for this position).

Why Join Us?

    Innovative Environment: Be part of a company that is at the forefront of surface science technology.
    Global Impact: Work with a dynamic, goal-oriented team to make a significant global impact.
    Collaborative Culture: A supportive and collaborative work environment where your contribution is valued.

title: Project Planner/Engineer
description:
Description

At Aquatech, we tackle the challenges of water scarcity and complexity by leveraging technology, expertise, and financing to deliver comprehensive solutions that reduce carbon and recycled water footprint. As a leading global provider of water and process technology solutions, we help the world's most recognized companies achieve their sustainability and operational goals by implementing innovative approaches for water reuse, desalination, minimal and zero liquid discharge, and critical minerals recovery. Our work catalyzes the transition toward a more sustainable future and showcases our commitment to addressing water's role in climate adaptation. Learn more at www.aquatech.com

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Project Engineer/Planner to work on our site in Boden, Sweden.

The ideal candidate will be organized, have excellent math skills, applied creativity, mechanical skills, problem-solving skills, team-oriented, customer service driven, and have attention to detail. This candidate will also have experience in a project-related industry.

Job Description

    Review of Project specifications
    Preparation of Project Documents
    Maintain the Project Master document list.
    Lead project design coordination with internal engineering departments, external engineering agencies, and Site Contractors.
    Coordinate engineering document submissions to customers & vendors.
    Facilitate timely engineering reviews of vendor quotes.
    Review vendor quotes and purchase requisitions for compliance with project specifications.
    Responsible for accurately reporting engineering progress in the project schedule.
    Coordinate the collection of necessary inputs to the 3D model and the resolution of issue tags.
    Provide status, control, and progress reporting support services on projects.
    Prepare project schedules per project requirements.
    Verify the project progress & prepare the monthly progress report.
    Vendor follow-up & expediting
    Periodic vendor visits to monitor the progress.
    Attend Customer meetings as required.
    Support correspondence with customers via the Project manager.
    Internal communication with all departments & AIC Assembly shop.
    Track material status in SAP & update project status
    Preparation of packing slips & related shipment documentation
    Site visits during the construction phase
    Coordinate engineering responses to RFI from subcontractors
    Expedite critical engineering solutions during the construction phase.
    Ensure design changes are properly communicated to the project team and incorporated into the 3D model.
    Oversee as-built documentation for the project.
    Work autonomously without constant guidance
    10% International and Domestic travel will be required.

Skill Requirements:

    Able to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
    Time management and organizational skills.
    Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex documents.
    Ability to read and interpret AutoCAD engineering drawings and P&IDs.
    Ability to communicate effectively with customers and maintain a positive attitude.
    Ability to work with multiple disciplines on projects.
    Ability to plan and manage multiple tasks or projects with attention to detail.
    Ability to use MS Office software at a high level of proficiency.
    Ability to use SAP.
    Ability to use Primavera P6 preferred.
    Experience using AutoCAD 2D and Plant 3D preferred.

Essential Functions:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Physical Job Demands:

Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time, limited walking, and standing.



Qualifications

    Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering
    Five (5) or more years of experience in a project-related industry
    Prior water/wastewater infrastructure project experience preferred.

title: Finance Manager, RFM, Resins
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Finance Manager is responsible for driving financial planning, forecasting, and performance management across the business unit. The role partners closely with business leaders to support decision-making, optimize resource allocation, and ensure delivery of sustainable growth and productivity initiatives.

This position reports to the Sr Director, Finance for Resins & Technologies and is part of the Finance organization located in Uppsala, Sweden. This is an on-site role.

What you'll do:

    Business Unit Finance Processes Leadership
    Lead monthly forecasting, Annual Operating Plan and monthly closing processes; analyze revenue, margin, operating expenses and operating profit performance; deliver business reviews; drive forecast accuracy; support KPI development and performance analytics.
    Business Unit Strategic Investment & Capital Portfolio Finance
    Provide financial oversight for capital investments including capacity expansion, productivity, automation and growth projects. Partner with the Global PMO Leader, lead capital planning and forecasting, monitor spending and provide portfolio governance.
    Review and challenge capital investment proposals. Evaluate NPV, IRR, payback and ROI. Support capital approval processes and provide recommendations on project prioritization and capital allocation.
    Track delivery of approved financial benefits, conduct post-investment reviews, develop portfolio dashboards and drive accountability for investment returns.
    Business Partnership
    Partner closely with the Business Unit CFO on FP&A activities including forecasting, planning, and business performance management, while serving as the primary finance partner to the Global PMO Leader for strategic investment planning, capital governance, and value realization.
    DBS & Continuous Improvement
    Drive simplification and standardization of FP&A and capital governance processes while supporting DBS and productivity initiatives.
    Partner with local and global stakeholders to identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and digital solutions to enhance financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and decision-making processes.

Who you are:

    Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.
    Multiple years of experience in FP&A, forecasting, annual operating planning and business performance management within an industrial environment.
    Experience evaluating capital investments and business cases using financial valuation methodologies such as NPV, IRR, payback and ROI.
    Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP and financial planning systems such as Oracle, SAP, OneStream or Business Objects.
    Fluent in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

    Leading projects, workstreams or cross-functional teams.
    Supporting capital portfolio management, manufacturing investments, large-scale productivity programs or continuous improvement initiatives.
    A strong interest in leveraging AI, automation and digital technologies to improve finance processes, increase productivity and enhance decision-making.

You are highly analytical and business-oriented, with the ability to translate financial insights into impactful decisions. You build strong partnerships across functions, communicate complex topics with clarity, and effectively drive results through collaboration and influence. You thrive in a continuous improvement environment, embrace change, and are motivated by creating value for the business.

title: Hub General Manager
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Lead the future of PSD Hub ÖrebroAre you an experienced leader who thrives in complex, global environments and enjoys bringing people, functions, and strategies together? We are looking for a Hub General Manager to lead Parts & Services Division (PSD) Hub Örebro through an important transformation journey. This is a highly visible leadership role where you will bring together approximately 200 employees and 30 managers across multiple functions, strengthening collaboration, alignment, and engagement while helping shape the hub's future as a Solution Acceleration Center. The role reports to Vice President Operations, Christel Fuellenbach.



Join our teamPSD Hub Örebro brings together a broad range of capabilities, including engineering, technical service, service training, marketing, pricing, communications, e-commerce, and operational support functions. As Hub General Manager, you will act as the senior focal point for the hub and collaborate closely with divisional leadership, global stakeholders, HR, unions, Product Companies, and Customer Centers worldwide. The role is also part of PSD's global hub network, working closely with colleagues in Nanjing, Nashik, Garland, and Johannesburg.



Your missionYour mission is to create one aligned and high-performing hub organization while driving the transformation toward a stronger business-oriented and market-connected operating model.



Key priorities include:




    Building collaboration and a strong "one hub, one team" culture across functions and locations.
    Leading through influence in an environment with primarily indirect leadership responsibilities.
    Acting as the main interface between the hub and key stakeholders across the business.
    Strengthening cross-functional cooperation between engineering, operations, marketing, sourcing, and customer-facing organizations.
    Supporting the development of structures that improve value creation, revenue visibility, and solution commercialization.
    Driving organizational change while maintaining employee engagement and trust.  



Your profileWe believe you are an experienced leader who enjoys creating clarity, bringing people together, and driving change in complex organizations.



You have likely:




    Successfully led organizational transformation and change initiatives.
    Experience from large, cross-functional, and international organizations.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust across different levels of an organization.
    A collaborative leadership style with excellent communication skills.
    Experience from service, engineering, operations, aftermarket, or related business environments.



Experience from matrix organizations, indirect leadership, or commercial transformation is highly valued.



We know that great candidates do not always meet every single requirement. If this role interests you and you believe your experience can contribute to our success, we encourage you to apply.



Our leadership expectationsAt Epiroc, we expect our leaders to be inspirers, accelerators, and new thinkers. We value leaders who lead by example and have the courage to challenge the status quo. Safety and sustainability are our top priorities, and we expect our leaders to actively promote safety, inclusion, and diversity, while also prioritizing the well-being and continuous development of our employees. We are looking for you who have the courage to believe in new ideas and see opportunities where others see challenges.



Why Epiroc?By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.



To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:




    Global career opportunities
    Learning & Development programs
    Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
    Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
    Global Parental Leave Policy
    Community involvement



Location and otherÖrebro, Sweden. Occasional international travel.



Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 31, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.



We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.



For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager: Christel Fuellenbach, Vice President Operations, christel.fuellenbach@epiroc.comRecruitment Specialist: Otto Wetterström, otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com

title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer - Finance
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

_______________________________________________________________________________

To strengthen our capabilities in analytics engineering and data visualisation, Etraveli Group is now recruiting a Senior Business Intelligence Developer with a focus on Finance to join the BI team.

The role can be located in either Uppsala or Stockholm.

About the job

You will be joining our BI team in creating and maintaining data pipelines and relevant business intelligence applications. The latter are presently created in Qlik Sense and Looker. Work is also underway to evolve our tech stack by implementing dbt and a new data platform. You will play a vital role in this journey, taking a major part in shaping how our BI team evolves its ways of working.

Your role will require both a deep understanding of the business needs and the skill set to acquire, handle and analyse the relevant data. You will have a close direct connection and collaboration with other groups and departments acting as stakeholders for the applications you develop.

Our BI team is split across the offices in Uppsala, Stockholm, Göteborg, Mumbai and Athens, and caters to the whole organisation. In total we are nineteen developers and our processes and technical setup are mature, but constantly adapting to the business and the technical landscape.

The data you will be using is mostly structured in databases maintained by the IT-department and we use several different database technologies. Less structured data will also occur frequently.

Working at Etraveli Group means working at a company with grand plans and great expectations. You will have awesome colleagues together with whom you will solve complex problems in a fast-moving business.

To summarise the job will include:

    development of business intelligence applications, focusing primarily on financial reporting and analytics
    

    analytics engineering, data modelling, and building robust data pipelines
    

    taking a senior role and contribute to define how the BI-team should adopt work in the new data platform
    

    working closely and directly with stakeholders, especially within the Finance department

Requirements

You need to be passionate about business and numbers since the job requires both a deep understanding of the business needs, as well as the ability to acquire, handle and analyse the relevant data. Personality-wise you are curious, methodical, ambitious and thorough. More formally, you have:

    a university degree in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, engineering or similar)
    

    either or both: extensive professional experience of development in some Business Intelligence tools (e.g., QlikView, Qlik Sense, Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and/or experience with analytics engineering, writing pipelines for analytical data in a data warehouse technology. Experience with dbt, Dremio and/or spark in particular are seen as big advantages
    

    demonstrated abilities in handling data with code and to produce meaningful data visualizations that can drive insights
    

    strong communication skills including excellent command of spoken and written English

Experience working with financial data, financial reporting concepts, or ERP systems is highly beneficial, as you will be working closely with our Finance department.

Benefits

Working at Etraveli Group means working at a fast-growing company with high ambitions in becoming the number one Online travel agency worldwide. The culture at the company embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company.

We offer:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid model where you can choose to work two days from home and two weeks per year from a remote location.
    

    Central office locations – We are located on Regeringsgatan in Stockholm and Dragarbrunnsgatan in Uppsala, a stone's throw from public transport and lunch restaurants.
    

    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    

    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

Welcome to Etraveli Group!

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.
