description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

Job Purpose

Etraveli Group has ~3,000 employees and uses market-leading agentic tools and production autonomous agents to drive productivity across all functions, including bespoke use cases.

This role owns rollout, standards, training, and support for our agentic toolkit, alongside leading the Tech/Legal cross-functional governance forum.

A hands-on position focused on configuring platforms, creating guides/assets, running user sessions, and scaling adoption within Data & AI.

The role can be based in Stockholm or Uppsala.

Duties and Responsibilities

Rollout and Adoption

    Own business-side rollout, functional onboarding, and train-the-trainer initiatives.
    

    Partner with IT on licensing and backend configuration (e.g., connectors/MCPs) to drive adoption.
    

    Secure management alignment across departments and continuously optimize tooling rollout routines.
    

    Track model spend against usage to optimize cost vs. value.

Standards and Reusable Assets

    Establish practical AI standards, project structures, and output verification protocols.
    

    Provide plain-language guidance on tool selection and data classification compliance.
    

    Build and curate a shared library of prompts, skills, workflows, and evaluate new stack tools everything from memory to managed agents

Training and Support

    Design/deliver training programs with HR (onboarding, functional tracks, power-user deep dives).
    

    Lead a champions network and run senior sponsor education programs.
    

    Educate users on efficient, cost-effective tool usage and context structuring.
    

    Support users hands-on to help them solve their business problems with the help of AI

Governance Operations and Support

    Manage the AI governance forum intake/agenda, structuring cases for Tech and Legal review.
    

    Act as the primary contact for teams proposing new personal AI tools / connectivity, screening for technical and practical feasibility.
    

    Communicate responsible use standards (data guardrails and mandatory verification) across the organization

Measurement and Opportunities

    Own adoption KPIs (tracking weekly active usage and AI maturity per function).
    

    Identify and resolve cultural, practical, or technical adoption blockers with leadership.
    

    Manage the promotion path for proven self-serve workflows to transition into centrally built engineering projects.

Qualifications / Personal Characteristics

Must Have

    Proven track record of rolling out internal tools/platforms (access, onboarding waves, support).
    

    Daily power user of LLMs with experience building prompts, projects, Gems, skills, or workflows.
    

    Experience designing and delivering non-technical training and clear documentation.
    

    Solid technical understanding of LLMs, agents, tool use, and retrieval mechanisms.
    

    Ability to define adoption metrics and present structured business cases to senior leadership, Legal, and Tech partners.

Nice to Have

    Hands-on experience administering Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot or a comparable enterprise AI platform.
    

    Experience driving adoption of more than one overlapping tool at once.
    

    Python or similar at prototyping level.
    

    Background in L&D or training design.
    

    Experience in a multi-country organisation with a large operational workforce.

Benefits

The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company.

With us you can enjoy:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location
    

    Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
    

    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    

    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
    

    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Data Protection Officer / Dataskyddsombud
description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Protection Officer / Dataskyddsombud for a long-term consulting assignment.

Period: 2026-11-01 – 2030-12-31

Scope: Approximately 30–60% over time

Location: Remote

Deadline: 2026-10-07

About the assignment

The role involves independent monitoring, review, reporting, and advisory work within data protection. You will support compliance with GDPR and other applicable data protection legislation and provide practical, risk-based recommendations.

Responsibilities

    Monitor compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection legislation.
    Conduct risk-based reviews, audits, and follow-ups.
    Prepare reports on risks, observations, and recommendations.
    Monitor regulatory developments and data protection practices.
    Provide advice on data protection matters and new processing activities.
    Support DPIAs and other privacy risk assessments.
    Assess third-country transfers and Transfer Impact Assessments (TIA).
    Review data processing agreements and related contractual matters.
    Provide advice regarding personal data incidents and notification requirements.
    Follow up previous recommendations and identify areas requiring further attention.

Requirements

    Relevant education and current professional experience in data protection.
    At least two relevant assignments within the last three years.
    Strong knowledge of GDPR and applicable data protection legislation.
    Experience with DPIA, TIA, data processing agreements, and privacy risk assessments.
    Experience advising on personal data incidents.
    Excellent Swedish communication skills, both written and spoken.
    Independent, structured, analytical, and pedagogical working approach.

Assignment: Consultant

Working method: Remote

Start: 2026-11-01

End: 2030-12-31

Scope: Approx. 30–60%

Response deadline: 2026-10-07

title: Hotellchef till Skara Konsthotell
description:
Hotellchef till Skara Konsthotell

Vill du leda en verksamhet där hotell, mat och konst möts? Vi söker en engagerad hotellchef som vill utveckla Skara Konsthotell tillsammans med våra medarbetare och skapa upplevelser som får gästerna att återvända.

Skara Konsthotell är en del av Jula Hotell och ingår i Julakoncernen, där utveckling och nyfikenhet driver oss framåt. Hos oss arbetar vi tillsammans och är där gästen är.

Med 98 hotellrum, konferenslokaler, restaurang och konsthall erbjuder vi en unik miljö för både privatgäster och affärsresenärer. I restaurangen står lokala råvaror i centrum. I konsthallen möter gästerna verk av några av Sveriges främsta konstnärer, bland andra Anders Zorn och Carl Larsson, samt tillfälliga utställningar med lokala konstnärer.

Din roll som hotellchef

Som hotellchef har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhetens drift, personal, kvalitet och lönsamhet. Du arbetar både operativt och strategiskt, med fokus på att utveckla affären, skapa en god arbetsmiljö och ge våra gäster en upplevelse av hög kvalitet.

Du är närvarande i verksamheten och leder genom dina underställda chefer. Genom tydliga mål, stöd och uppföljning ger du dem förutsättningar att utveckla sina team och verksamheten. Tillsammans skapar ni arbetssätt som stärker både service och resultat.

Du leder hotellets ledningsgrupp, rapporterar till VD och ingår i Jula Hotells centrala ledningsgrupp.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

    Leda och utveckla verksamheten genom ett nära och engagerat ledarskap.
    Driva försäljning och affärsutveckling samt följa upp resultat.
    Ta fram budget och prognoser samt löpande följa upp ekonomi och drift tillsammans med VD.
    Förhandla lokala avtal och följa upp inköp och kostnader.
    Planera evenemang tillsammans med ditt team.
    Ta fram hotellets marknadsplan tillsammans med vår centrala försäljningsavdelning.
    Säkerställa en god arbetsmiljö och en bemanning som möter verksamhetens behov.

Din bakgrund och erfarenhet

Vi söker dig som har ledarerfarenhet och en god förståelse för hur ekonomi, bemanning och kvalitet påverkar verksamhetens resultat. Du är trygg med att använda rapporter och ekonomiska analyser som underlag för beslut och förbättringar.

För rollen behöver du ha:

    Erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare.
    Ekonomisk utbildning eller lång erfarenhet av att arbeta med ekonomiska rapporter och förstå ekonomiska analyser.
    Vana att ta fram budget och prognoser.
    Erfarenhet av inköp och av att arbeta i system för leverantörsfakturor.
    Vana att arbeta i schemaläggningsprogram.

Det är meriterande om du även har:

    Erfarenhet från hotell- och restaurangbranschen.
    Erfarenhet av att leda andra chefer och ledare.
    Erfarenhet av försäljning och revenue management.
    Erfarenhet från campingbranschen.

Du som person

Du är en öppen, varm och social ledare som skapar förtroende och samarbete. Du lyssnar, engagerar och ger andra utrymme att växa, samtidigt som du är tydlig med förväntningar och fattar beslut även när de är svåra.

Du trivs i en verksamhet där tempot varierar och flera frågor behöver hanteras samtidigt. Med struktur och noggrannhet prioriterar du det som är viktigast, delegerar när det behövs och agerar snabbt när förutsättningarna förändras.

Du har ett gott ekonomiskt sinne och ser möjligheter att utveckla både affären och gästupplevelsen. Din nyfikenhet, servicekänsla och förmåga att omsätta idéer i handling hjälper dig att driva verksamheten framåt tillsammans med ditt team.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Bra att veta

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Jula Hotell har kollektivavtal med Unionen.

Så här söker du

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-31. Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdagen, så skicka gärna din ansökan redan idag. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta VD Patrik Turnesjö på mailto:patrik.turnesjo@julahotell.se

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Senior UI Designer
description:
Would you like to shape how players experience a game, from the first interaction to the details that make each feature easy and enjoyable to use?

As a Senior UI Designer at Snowprint, you’ll design and implement UI for our games, working closely with designers, developers, artists, and other disciplines to turn ideas into experiences that players can use and enjoy. You’ll have ownership of your work, from early concepts and wireframes through to testing and improvement.

At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and self-leadership are what make great games possible. We work in small teams where people are trusted to take ownership, share ideas openly, and contribute beyond their own discipline. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how we approach UI, establish good practices, and help create experiences that put the player first.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll design UI for new features and game systems, creating wireframes, mockups, and interaction patterns that make complex functionality clear and easy to use. You’ll bring your designs into Unity using UI Toolkit, working hands-on to turn them into polished, functional experiences.

You’ll playtest and evaluate your work regularly, gathering feedback and using it to improve the player experience. You’ll work closely with game designers, client developers, artists, and other team members throughout planning, development, and testing.

You’ll also contribute to how we work with UI as a discipline. This includes establishing best practices, creating useful workflows, and helping maintain consistency across the game. You’ll have room to influence the direction of the UI while balancing design principles with the practical realities of production.

Is this you?

You’re an experienced UI Designer with professional experience designing for games, including mobile and touch interfaces. You have worked on at least one game in a free-to-play, midcore, turn-based strategy, live-operated, or external IP environment, with experience across several of these areas being particularly relevant.

You have experience implementing UI in Unity, and if you have experience with UI Toolkit that would be great. You’re comfortable working with tools such as Figma, the Google Suite, and Adobe Suite, and have experience with version control such as GitHub.

You care about practical UI/UX design and getting your work into the hands of players. You understand common patterns and best practices in mobile games, but also know when consistency needs to give way to a better solution for the player or the product.

You pay attention to detail and understand that not every problem needs a perfect solution. You’re comfortable giving and receiving feedback, asking questions, and discussing your ideas openly. You take ownership of your work and enjoy working with others to find solutions that balance design, technical constraints, and production needs.

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment — while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.

Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.

For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

title: Control System Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Control Systems Engineer to lead and support the development and sustaining of SIMATIC SPPA-T3000 and PCS 7 control system for our medium gas turbines. As a part of our team, you will develop and maintain control system software applications for our medium gas turbines to ensure our products meet the requirements set in the market. The position requires close collaboration and working alongside other departments and designers to integrate control system into the overall design of MGT products.

How You Will Make an Impact

    Be a part of a highly skilled development team responsible for the development and maintenance of control system software applications for the MGT products.
    Be responsible for the engineering work and technical solutions in the assigned development projects, working closely with the project team and project manager to ensure that the design meets specified requirements aligned with the technical road map.
    Design and configure T3000 and PCS 7 control systems, including control logic, hardware setup, server and computer networks, safety systems, trip chains, and HMI/OS displays, while adhering to configuration management, version control, and rigorous testing to ensure system integrity.
    Integrate field instrumentation and subsystems; manage communications via common industrial protocols (e.g., ProfNet, Profibus, Modbus TCP, and OPC).
    Apply industry standards and best practices for safety, quality, and cybersecurity.
    Consistently acquire new skills and knowledge while sharing them by mentoring and assisting others over time. Contribute to enhancing our processes and methods to improve team performance and project outcomes within the team’s responsibilities.

What You Will Bring

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in control engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
    3+ years of experience working with automation and control technologies, with an interest in new technologies and the use of existing technologies in new contexts.
    Proficient English skills, allowing you to express yourself fluently and communicate effectively at a professional level.
    Excellent interpersonal skills combined with experience working with colleagues and customers in international settings.

Experience in the following areas is advantageous:

    SPPA-T3000 and/or PCS 7
    Modeling and simulation in MATLAB or a related tool
    Functional Safety (SIL)
    Cybersecurity
    System networking and VMware

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 301066 not later than 2026-10-15

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

Location: Finspång

title: Supply Chain Process Specialist
description:
At Beiersdorf, home of Nivea, Eucerin, Hansaplast & Labello we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.



We are looking for a proactive, business-focused Process Specialist to lead the development and optimisation of customer management and Supply Chain processes across the Nordics.



Acting as the Nordic SAP customer management SME, you will drive best practices, translate business requirements into effective system solutions, and collaborate with global SAP key users and IT teams to deliver continuous improvement.



As part of our digital transformation journey, you will leverage technologies such as AI, Microsoft Copilot, and automation tools to improve efficiency, simplify processes, and develop innovative solutions that enhance employee and customer experiences.



To stay connected to customer needs, you will periodically support customer order management activities, using these insights to identify process improvements and strengthen the overall customer experience.



This is a Fixed Term Contract up to 15 months



Your Tasks

    Lead the implementation of global customer management projects and digital transformation initiatives within the Nordic region, working in close collaboration with the Global SAP key user community
    Act as the primary point of contact for SAP-related matters within the Nordic Supply Chain organization, including the creation and management of IT support tickets as needed.
    Drive the adoption and effective use of AI-powered tools, including Microsoft Copilot, to improve productivity and process efficiency.
    Identifying recurring process failures and working on sustainable corrective actions
    Identify opportunities for automation and lead initiatives that eliminate manual activities and simplify workflows.
    Design, develop, or coordinate the implementation of automation solutions and bots that improve operational performance and service quality.
    Maintain strong process governance by ensuring key processes are documented, updated, and followed.
    Coordinate EDI-related projects in collaboration with internal IT functions and customers' IT departments
    Support customer order management activities when needed to maintain operational insight and identify opportunities for improvement



Your Profile

    Strong experience working with SAP or similar ERP systems; EDI understanding is a plus.
    Strong understanding of customer management, order-to-cash and supply chain processes.
    Experience driving process improvements, system enhancements, or business transformation initiatives.
    Experience working with AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, or similar technologies
    Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data and insights into practical actions and improvements.
    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate and simplify messages across functions and organizational levels
    A continuous improvement mindset and a passion for process excellence and customer experience.



Please submit your CV in English



At Beiersdorf, we see you as a person – far beyond your title or role. Our goal is to provide the flexibility and support you need for your professional and personal success through our work environment. That is why we have a lot to offer!



    Competitive salary
    Bonus
    Private Health Insurance
    Pension
    30 days vacation per year
    Wellness fee
    Meal vouchers
    Discounted product purchases
    Leave entitlements and wellbeing support to include access to an excellent Employee Assistance Programme



At Beiersdorf, we believe that every individual brings unique perspectives, experiences, and strengths that deserve to be valued and celebrated. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where everyone feels empowered to be themselves, thrive in their role, and work in ways that enable them to succeed. Through flexibility, understanding, accessibility, and meaningful support, we aim to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, heard, and able to reach their full potential.



We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment experience and are happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process to support you.

title: Experienced Solution Architect - Cloud, Solna
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of cloud-based API solutions? Join PostNord in Stockholm as an experienced Solution Architect and help build digital services that make a real difference.

At PostNord, technology and social responsibility come together to create digital solutions used by millions of people every day. As an experienced Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping our digital future. We offer a collaborative, forward-looking environment where innovation is encouraged, ideas are valued, and your work has a meaningful impact.

What We Offer You

    A strategic role with the opportunity to influence key architectural decisions and the design of future-ready system support.

    Work with clear social relevance, contributing to logistics solutions that support people, businesses, and society.

    A value-driven workplace that prioritizes wellbeing, flexibility, and sustainable work-life balance.

    Strong opportunities for professional development, including sponsorship for cloud certifications.

    A hybrid way of working, with access to a newly renovated office in Solna.

What You Will Do With Us

You will join Sender Solutions within Customer Solutions at PostNord Group IT. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Booking API team and other teams across Sender Solutions to define architecture that meets today’s business needs while preparing for tomorrow’s opportunities. Our solutions must meet high expectations for reliability, scalability, and efficiency, supporting both our customers and our long-term technology strategy.

Your role in brief

    Shape the design and architecture of digital shipping solutions in close collaboration with the tech lead, product owner, and colleagues in the team.

    Spend part of your time contributing hands-on as a system developer in the Booking API team, maintaining deep solution knowledge and staying closely connected to the team’s day-to-day work.

    Contribute to the development and maintenance of large-scale solutions and integrations with complex dependencies.

    Represent Sender Solutions in cross-area architecture forums, working closely with tech leads across the area.

    Support product owners and teams in dialogue with major customers.

    Drive innovation and continuous improvement to deliver solutions that meet evolving customer needs.

You will join a skilled team of around ten developers working across both back-end and front-end development. You will work closely with the team’s product owner, and your immediate manager will be Annika Dahlström. The team uses technologies such as:

    AWS Microservices / Serverless.

    NodeJS / JavaScript / TypeScript / Java

    DynamoDB, Postgres, SQS, IAM, OAuth2, Fargate, S3, Elasticsearch, to name a few.

    Swagger, Grafana, GitHub, XML/JSON, CI/CD

We are an engaged and ambitious team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Most of the team works from our office in Solna, with additional developers based in the Philippines. We apply a hybrid working model, with at least 60% of working time spent at the office. For this role, we would welcome a Solution Architect who can be on site more frequently to support close collaboration. We also offer flexible working hours.

More About You

You are an experienced architect with solid expertise in cloud technologies, system development, and API development. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and thrive in a role where you guide, inspire, and support your team. You have an academic degree in IT, or equivalent practical experience, and communicate fluently in both Swedish and English. Experience from the logistics industry is an advantage, as is an understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI, can be applied to create business value. Above all, you are collaborative, strategic, and customer-focused. You communicate clearly and adapt your message to different audiences and levels of technical understanding.

About us

We move the Nordics forward. PostNord offers reliable and fast services in parcel, mail and integrated logistics across the Nordics, with a clear target of reaching net-zero emissions by 2040. By connecting people, places, and opportunities, we help our customers grow and provide convenient deliveries for consumers. With our unique Nordic network and climate leadership, we shape the future of e commerce and logistics. In 2025, the Group had around 27,000 employees and sales of SEK 36,2 billion. The Parent Company is a Swedish public limited company with Group headquarters in Solna, Sweden. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com

Apply

Welcome to submit your application. The selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, certain positions may require a background check. If you progress to a stage where a background check is necessary, you will be informed in advance.

If you have any questions or concerns, please email emina.delkic@postnord.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Read more about our union representatives

PostNord offers communications and logistics solutions to, from and within the Nordic region. With our expertise and a unique distribution network, we are developing the basis for tomorrow’s communication, e-commerce, distribution and logistics.

title: Hemstädare / Home cleaner - Hemfrid Gävle
description:
We are looking for new home cleaners to join our team in Gävle. Are you our next star? 🌟

Your profile We enjoy making our customers’ everyday lives easier – and so should you. You like working independently, are driven by quality and customer service, and have a positive, responsible attitude with an eye for details.

About the role As a home cleaner at Hemfrid, you clean customers’ homes with high quality. You work independently and focus on delivering the best service and client satisfaction.

Your work tasks include, among others:

    

Vacuuming and dusting.

    

Mopping floors and cleaning surfaces.

    

Strengthening, folding, and washing clothes.

    

Changing bedsheets and making the bed.

    

Give the customer’s home that little extra touch.

You should:

    

Have previous experience from a service profession.

    

Speak and understand basic Swedish or English.

    

Be able to work flexible hours, Monday – Friday, between 8 – 17.

    

Have a valid driving license and access to your own car.

It is a strong merit if you have worked as a home cleaner, housekeeper, or equivalent before.

We offer

Our goal is clear – we want to be the best employer in the industry. We believe our employees are the heart of the company, and we are dedicated to providing good working conditions.

Among others, we offer:

    

Fixed salary every month

    

A permanent position with a 50-75 % employment rate.

    

Collective agreement and favorable terms of employment.

    

Liability insurance, health insurance, and pension insurance.

    

Wellness allowance.

    

Training in home cleaning, with a focus on your development.

    

Great career opportunities and growth within Hemfrid.

    

Free mobile subscription.

    

One of Sweden’s greatest teams of colleagues from all over the world. 🙌

About Hemfrid

Hemfrid is Sweden's leading provider of home services. We help our customers with cleaning, laundry, ironing, moving, gardening, and more. By working as a team and providing easy access to first-class home services, we unlock people's quality of life.

Our process

As part of our recruitment process, we always do a background check. You need to have a Swedish personal number or a coordination number to be eligible for this position.

Curious about where we’re hiring? Discover all our locations here!

Welcome to Hemfrid!

Vi letar efter nya hemstädare till vårt team i Gävle. Är du vår nästa stjärna? 🌟

Din profil

Vi älskar att göra våra kunders vardag enklare – det borde du också göra. Vi söker efter någon som tycker om att arbeta självständigt och som drivs av kvalitet och kundservice. Du är punktlig och ansvarstagande, med ett öga för detaljer och en positiv inställning.

Om rollen

Som hemstädare på Hemfrid ansvarar du för att städa våra kunders hem med högsta kvalitet. Ditt uppdrag är att alltid erbjuda bästa möjliga service. Du arbetar självständigt och är ansvarig för att säkerställa att dina kunder är nöjda.

Dina arbetsuppgifter består bland annat av:

    

Dammsugning och dammtorkning.

    

Moppning och rengöring av ytor.

    

Strykning, vikning och tvätta kläder.

    

Byta lakan och bädda.

    

Ge det där lilla extra till kundens hem.

Du bör:

    

Ha tidigare erfarenhet från ett serviceyrke.

    

Tala och förstå grundläggande svenska eller engelska.

    

Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar, måndag – fredag, mellan 8 – 17.

    

Ha ett giltigt B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil.

Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska.

Vi erbjuder

Vårt mål är tydligt – vi vill vara branschens bästa arbetsgivare. Vi tror att våra anställda är företagets hjärta, och vi är dedikerade till att erbjuda bra arbetsförhållanden.

Bland annat erbjuder vi:

    

Samma fasta lön varje månad

    

En tillsvidareanställning med 50- 75 % sysselsättningsgrad.

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring och pensionsförsäkring.

    

Friskvårdsbidrag.

    

Utbildning inom hemstädning, med fokus på din utveckling.

    

Goda möjligheter att utvecklas och växa inom Hemfrid.

    

Gratis mobilabonnemang.

    

Ett av Sveriges härligaste team med kollegor från hela världen. 🙌

    

Om Hemfrid

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör för tjänster i hemmet. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, tvätt, strykning, flytt, trädgårdsarbete och mycket mer. Genom att arbeta som ett team och ge våra kunder enkel tillgång till våra toppklassiga tjänster förbättrar vi deras livskvalitet.

Vår process

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller. För att vara kvalificerad för den här tjänsten behöver du ha ett svenskt personnummer eller ett samordningsnummer.

Nyfiken på var vi söker personal? Upptäck alla områden här!

Välkommen till Hemfrid!

title: Open application - Data Center Technician to a World Leading Tech Company
description:
This advert is published due to recurring requests for candidates within this role. It helps us build a pipeline so we can act quickly when we receive a new assignment.

When we get a relevant request from a client, we will review applications from this ad and contact candidates whose profile matches the specific requirements. This also means you may not hear from us in between, as there may be no active assignment at the time.

Demand for this role can change quickly, and during the summer period it may not always be active.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

On behalf of one of the world’s leading and most recognized tech companies, we are looking for two skilled Data Center Technician to their Data Center in Gävle Sweden. If you are looking for a unique career opportunity, that will provide you with many chances to learn, grow and further develop your skills within IT, Support, Hardware, Servers and more than this could be the right role for you.

You will play a vital part in making the Data Centers daily operations run smoothly. The team you will be joining covers the below responsibilities:

    Prepares, stages, sets up, and performs startups and shutdowns (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches) according to specific instructions, checklists, guides, standard protocols, and emails.

    Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, OS rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.

Requirements:

    Basic knowledge of computer hardware, servers, and components.

    Basic understanding of how to use Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word).
    High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
    CompTIA / CCNA/ CDCP would be highly beneficial.
    To be considered for this role, you must hold a Swedish passport or permanent residency (PR).

We can offer you:

    Attractive working conditions
    Employment at one of the world’s most recognizes companies who over and over is celebrated as one of the world’s greatest places to work.
    Work schedule is full time.

Preferred start date: Depending on the request

End date: 6 months and very high possibility for longer and also to get a full time position at the client after a year.

Location: Gävle, Sweden

Application

You will be employed by Temp-Team Sweden, but working full-time at our client’s location. Our client wishes for the right candidate to be hired asap, thus we are reviewing applications and inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis. If you are interested and feel you are the right person for the job, send us a targeted CV in English as soon as possible.

It is very important that you communicate your experience within the above mentioned job details and requirements in your resume.

For any questions regarding the position please contact Elnaz Memarian at elm@temp-team.se or Kristina Gelevska at kga@temp-team.se

title: Growth & Marketing Associate

Build new contacts and business opportunities

1–4 years of experience in marketing, sales, growth, or business development

    

Experience in B2B environments

    

A proactive, self-driven mindset — someone who brings new ideas rather than waiting to be told what to do

    

Comfortable working independently, in a fast-changing environment

title: Site Engineering and Reliability Lead
description:
The Engineering Lead is responsible for providing engineering and reliability guidance and direction to the Helsingborg Site ensuring they are delivering “best-in-class” approaches with respect to all elements of engineering and reliability maintenance practices.  This person will actively work by: Supporting strategic decisions related to Helsingborg Site, providing flawless execution knowledge related to capital equipment & deployment of reliability initiatives, point of contact between the Site and the regional Technical Operation organization, and supporting engineering related urgent issues during the execution or manufacturing phases.

Responsibilities:                    

    Responsible for the site engineering and equipment reliability strategy.
    Responsible for site engineering project portfolio & asset stewardship consolidation in partnership with site Leadership.
    Responsible to commission and qualify all new and existing upgraded equipment at site inline with Kenvue’s C&Q policy.
    Direct, guide and provide oversight for the site CapEx portfolio including forecasting, prioritizing budgeting, controlling and reporting of the site capital plan, communicating status and health to site and network stakeholders.
    Responsible for delivering equipment, capital and automation upgrades and innovation at site through working with regional and global team.
    Responsible for Standard deployment of capital programs in line with health authority requirements meeting Kenvue compliance and quality standards.
    Coordinate and develop of Site Master Plan (3-5 years).
    As site leadership team member develop department annual budgets, monitoring/controlling performance of site.
    Responsible for 5-7 direct reports and their performance and developments.



Qualifications

    A bachelor’s degree of Engineering (preferable Masters) with functional and people management experience (preferably in OTC/Pharma).
    Ability to drive engineering operational excellence across the organization with measurable, financial, quality and cycle time results is required-
    Experience in engineering project management, capital portfolio and installations.
    Knowledge across corrective, planned and reliability maintenance.
    Expert in continuous improvement, coot cause problem solving and operation excellence.
    Proven ability to work effectively and drive alignment in a matrix management environment through effective communication, collaboration and influence.
    Strong understanding of the asset management and NPI (new product introduction) processes.
    Fluent in English language – writing, speaking and understanding.



Kenvue Helsingborg

The Kenvue site in Helsingborg, Sweden is the home of the strong and growing brand NICORETTE®, a global market leader in smoking cessation. In 2021 our production facility was recognized as a Lighthouse by World Economic Forum, marking us as a beacon in The Fourth Industrial Revolution.

The Helsingborg site is one of the largest employers in the city of Helsingborg, and the business is divided in two separate departments: Operations, where we house our manufacturing activities and R & D, our global development center for excellence working in three therapeutic areas for selfcare treatments: Smoking Cessation, Digestive Health and Cough & Cold. For more information, click here.

Background checks in the recruitment process

As a final candidate in our recruitment process, you may be subject to a background check. This process is important for us to ensure the quality of our recruitment process.

As part of this, it is important that we encourage you to make sure that the information in your CV is correct before submitting your application to us.

    Financial checks

What’s in it for you:

    Learning & Development Opportunities        
    Employee Resource Groups                

Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

title: Senior Accountant Central Europe
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Accountant Central Europe for a company in Gothenburg. Start is ASAP, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Assignment description and main responsibilities

    

Manage and oversee - together with Group Accounting and SSC team - all accounting operations, including billing, accounts receivable/payable, general ledger, and inventory accounting.

    

Lead Shared service team (SSC) with the SSC Team leads, review and oversee all activities related to the month-end, half-year and year-end close processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness in coordination with internal teams (group accounting, tax.).

    

Secure implementation of accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls in liaison with HQ Finance teams and Group Accounting.

    

Safeguard company assets and ensure SOX compliance. SoX controls performed by SSC team.

    

Prepare and present financial statements with SSC, EY, Auditors.

    

Review reconciliations, prepare reports, and analyses to senior leadership. (SSC team performing the monthly reconciliations)

    

Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and all relevant legal requirements in liaison with HQ Group Accounting, Tax and Technical Accounting.

    

Manage partnerships with external auditors, tax/regulatory authorities.

    

Drive process improvements requests and leverage technology to increase efficiency and accuracy.

    

Provide leadership and oversight across a shared service accounting function, ensuring alignment with company standards, service level agreements, and seamless integration with internal operation

﻿

Collaborate with:

    

Group Accounting, Tax, Internal Control & SSC team* to ensure monthly closing, compliance with Local legal/Group policies and Statutory filing on time.

    

Cross functional teams across the PSUs and Regions Governance and Control – secure execution and improvement of internal controls set by our global internal control team.

    

Liaise with external and internal auditors and ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley controls.

﻿

*SSC responsible for performing R2R, AP/AR, Cash & Bank activities

﻿

Deliveries

The Senior Accounting Manager for Central Europe will play an important role in managing the core accounting and financial report functions and operational efficiencies in the region. You will lead our accounting and financial report operations through strategic guidance, deep understanding of accounting principles and regulatory compliance. You will play a pivotal role in shaping our financial future, ensuring compliance, and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional value to our customers and stakeholders. This role will be a key member of our finance community, ensuring consistent alignment across our business units and seamless integration of accounting operations in Central Europe, which today consists of a group of legal entities located in Austria, Germany and Switzerland. This role reports to the Regional CFO.

﻿

Competence requirements

    

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field required.

    

Master’s Degree in a related field, MBA and/or CPA Certification preferred.

    

5-10 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

    

Proven experience managing and collaborating across shared service accounting teams, ensuring high-quality performance and effective partnership.

    

Experience in the automotive industry or a related sector is strongly preferred.

    

Deep knowledge of GAAP/IFRS, financial reporting, and compliance requirements for the markets within the region.

    

Proven abilities working for a U.S. listed company environment with strong understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley Act and other regulatory requirements.

    

Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.

    

Proficient in accounting software and ERP systems; experience with dealership management systems a plus.

    

Skilled at identifying process gaps and driving optimization initiatives across various functions.

    

Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a passion for innovation and teamwork.

﻿

Other requirements

    

Fluent in English. German, Italian and French a plus.

    

Ability to navigate complexity in matrixed organizations

    

Strong prioritization abilities both in your own scope, your team, and deliverables to best support business objectives

﻿

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 8 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: Customer Service Representative

title: Technical Package Manager - Special Foundations
employer: HOCHTIEF Infrastructure GmbH Tyskland Sverige     Filial
description:
Technical Package Manager - Special Foundations

OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden

Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure

HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Technical Package Manager – Special Foundations to join the OL31 project in Vagnhärad. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a major infrastructure development, where you will be responsible for driving coordination, fostering collaboration across multiple stakeholders, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution.

About the Role

As Technical Package Manager - Special Foundations, you will take technical ownership of all special foundation works within the project. The role requires a highly experienced specialist with extensive knowledge of both the design and construction of special foundation systems.

You will be responsible for reviewing and challenging engineering designs produced by external designers and consultants, ensuring that proposed solutions are technically sound, buildable, compliant, and suitable for construction. You will act as the key technical authority for foundation-related matters throughout the project lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities

·        Lead the technical management of the Special Foundations package throughout the project lifecycle.

·        Review, verify and challenge foundation designs prepared by engineering consultants and designers.

·        Perform detailed design reviews to ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable standards and best engineering practices.

·        Evaluate the constructability, feasibility and technical suitability of proposed foundation solutions.

·        Assess geotechnical reports, design calculations, technical specifications and construction methodologies.

·        Ensure compliance with Swedish regulations, Eurocodes and project-specific requirements.

·        Provide technical guidance to project management, procurement teams and construction personnel.

·        Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies.

·        Support procurement activities, tender evaluations and technical clarifications related to foundation works.

·        Coordinate with designers, contractors, geotechnical specialists and other project stakeholders.

·        Monitor site execution and ensure that construction works are carried out in accordance with approved designs and quality standards.

·        Manage technical interfaces between foundation works and other project disciplines.



Your Profile

Required Qualifications & Experience

·        Degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering or a related field.

·        Minimum 7 years of experience in a senior technical role involving special foundations, geotechnical engineering or heavy civil construction.

·        Proven experience in both the design and execution of special foundation works.

·        Demonstrated ability to independently review and validate engineering designs prepared by third parties.

·        Strong understanding of geotechnical design principles, structural behavior and construction methodologies.

·        Experience with foundation systems such as: Piling works, Deep foundations, Ground improvement solutions, Retaining structures, Earth retention systems and Ground stabilization techniques, etc.

·        Experience on large industrial, infrastructure or complex construction projects.

·        Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

·        Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Language Requirements

    Professional working proficiency in English is required.
    Swedish is highly meritorious due to the project's regulatory environment, documentation requirements.

We Offer

    The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
    An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
    Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
    The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.



Location

Vagnhärad, Sweden



Apply

If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.



Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,

or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/



Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege Pensum nach Vereinbarung für die Region Aarau gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Aarau sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Aarau: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Sofort

**Arbeitsort:** Region Aarau

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Aarau, die Hauptstadt des Kantons Aargau, liegt zentral in der Nordwestschweiz und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direkten Bahnverbindungen zu den Wirtschaftszentren Zürich und Basel. Die Stadt bietet Ihnen vielfältige Arbeitsplätze in Industrie, Dienstleistungen und Verwaltung bei gleichzeitig moderater Kostenstruktur. Die hohe Lebensqualität, das kulturelle Angebot und die Nähe zu Erholungsgebieten machen Aarau zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort für Fachkräfte.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Aarau aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

- Zwingend für diese Stelle: Pensum frei wählbar!

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Aarau verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Aarau besteht eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH für die Langzeitpflege, da der demografische Wandel den Bedarf kontinuierlich steigert. Sie profitieren von hervorragenden Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt mit flexiblen Pensumsmodellen und attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler durch gezielte Stellenplatzierungen, umfassende Beratung und die schnelle Vermittlung zu seriösen Arbeitgebern, wodurch Ihr Einstieg in ein passendes Pensum deutlich vereinfacht wird.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Aarau

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Aarau

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Aarau wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

- Senden Sie uns darum noch heute Ihre Bewerbung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Aarau – wir begleiten Sie dabei persönlich.

(Senior) Consultant Data \& Analytics

* Du denkst in Ergebnissen und nicht Buzzwords und verwandelst für unsere Kunden Daten und AI in Umsatz, Effizienz und bessere Verkaufserlebnisse
* Du berätst an der Schnittstelle von Business, Data \& Technology und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Software Engineers, IT\-Architekten und Business Stakeholder

* Du arbeitest in schlanken, schlagkräftigen Teams – remote und beim Kunden vor Ort in der Schweiz
* Als Senior Consultant übernimmst du die selbstständige Leitung von grossen konzeptionellen und technischen Projekten bei strategisch wichtigen Kunden und gestaltest das Offering im Bereich Daten und KI aktiv mit


**Was du mitbringst**

* Du hast einen Universitäts\- / Fachhochschulabschluss mit einem quantitativen Fokus (z. B. Informatik, Statistik, VWL, etc.)

* Du kennst gängige Tools und Technologien im Data \& Analytics und AI\-Bereich und verstehst, was deren Capabilities und Einsatzbereiche sind
* Erfahrungen mit spezifischen Technologien zur Datenaufbereitung und –visualisierungen wie PowerBI, Data Bricks Delta Lake, Snowflake und Fabric sind ein Pluspunkt
* Du hast bereits Erfahrung gesammelt im Pre\-Sales und Sales und bist motiviert unser Leistungsangebot weiterzuentwickeln und am Markt zu etablieren
* Du bist ein strategischer und analytischer Denker mit starken konzeptionellen, planerischen und kommunikativen Fähigkeiten
* Du bist erfahren im Management verschiedenster Stakeholder\-Gruppen, inkl. C\-Level Führungskräfte
* Du bist ein guter Storyteller und bringst komplexe Sachverhalte in Workshops und Präsentationen problemlos auf den Punkt
* Du übernimmst Verantwortung und Initiative, bist kollaborativ und schätzt eine offene und konstruktive Feedback\-Kultur
* Du hast einwandfreie Deutsch\- und Englisch\-Kenntnisse  
* Bevorzugt: Erfahrung mit modernen KI\-gestützten Analyse\- und Recherchewerkzeugen wie Claude AI, NotebookLM, Microsoft Copilot oder ähnlich


**Wir suchen dich – werde Teil unseres Teams**

Berate dort, wo Daten den Unterschied machen – in Banking, Insurance, Public und Transportation. Du schaffst Klarheit in komplexen, regulierten Umfeldern und machst aus Rohdaten messbaren Business Impact. Wenn du in einem schlanken, schlagkräftigen Consulting\-Team eines renommierten Schweizer Technologieunternehmens arbeiten möchtest, mit viel Freiraum, einer flachen Hierarchie und direktem Zugang zu den Entscheidungsträgern, dann bist du bei uns richtig.

**Warum wir**

Swiss Arbeitgeber Award, Best of Swiss Apps oder Digital Economy Award. Unsere Arbeitsplatzkultur und unsere Projekte gewinnen Preise. Für unsere Kunden aus Banking, Retail oder Governance entwickeln wir nutzerzentrierte Digitalisierungslösungen. Abseits von vorgegebenen Pfaden kannst du bei uns Neues ausprobieren und dich so richtig austoben. Hier findest du alles, was dein Techie\-Herz begehrt: In einem dynamischen und kollegialen Umfeld treibst du deine innovativen Ideen voran – natürlich immer mithilfe der neuesten Technologien. Apropos Arbeitsplatzkultur: Agilität fordern wir nicht nur bei unseren Projekten, sondern fördern sie auch für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Birr liegt im malerischen Freiamt des Kantons Aargau und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage in einer hügeligen Landschaft. Die Gemeinde ist über die Bahnlinie Lenzburg-Muri gut mit den umliegenden Zentren verbunden und ermöglicht Sie komfortable Pendelfahrten. Als Arbeitsort bietet Birr eine ausgezeichnete Lebensqualität mit grünem Umfeld, günstigen Mieten und kurzen Wegen zum ländlich geprägten Charakter, der gerade für Fachkräfte und Familien zunehmend attraktiv wird.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Birr

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Suchtbehandlung

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Suchtbehandlung in Birr verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplomierten Pflegefachpersonal in der Suchtbehandlung in der Region Birr zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich knapp sind und Einrichtungen kontinuierlich expandieren. Sie profitieren als Fachperson von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf eine sichere Anstellung mit attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen und der Möglichkeit, Ihr Fachwissen in einem wachsenden Sektor einzusetzen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie dabei, den optimalen Arbeitgeber zu finden und erleichtert den Einstieg durch ihre fundierte Kenntnis des lokalen Stellenmarkts und ihre etablierten Kontakte zu führenden Arbeitgebern in der Suchtbehandlung.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Birr

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Suchtbehandlung in Birr

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

Mitarbeiter:in Technischer Support (m/w/d)
==========================================

**Mitarbeiter:in Technischer Support (m/w/d)**
----------------------------------------------

80–100 %, per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung, Widen AG (Region Zürich)



**Was dich bei Aliva erwartet**

Aliva ist ein Schweizer Maschinenbauunternehmen mit einem Team von rund 30 Personen, Teil der internationalen Normet\-Gruppe mit 1'800 Mitarbeitenden. Wir entwickeln und bauen Maschinen für Spritzbeton, die weltweit unter anderem im Tunnelbau und zur Sicherung von Baugruben zum Einsatz kommen.

Unsere Maschinen laufen dort, wo ein Stillstand teuer ist: im Tunnel, auf der Baustelle, oft weit weg von Widen. Damit sie laufen, braucht es jemanden, der die Maschine kennt, den Fehler am Telefon findet und dem Servicetechniker vor Ort den entscheidenden Hinweis gibt. Der Service ist ein Bereich, den wir in Widen ausbauen – und der technische Support ist seine Drehscheibe. Dafür suchen wir dich.



**Was du machst**

* Du unterstützt Kunden und Servicetechniker bei technischen Fragen zu unseren Rotormaschinen und deren Komponenten: Fehlersuche, Diagnose und Lösung – per Telefon, E\-Mail oder Remote.
* Du beurteilst eingehende Service\- und Reparaturfälle technisch, definierst die nötigen Arbeiten und bereitest Reparaturen, Revisionen und Umbauten administrativ und im System vor.
* Du erfasst Anfragen, Störungen und wiederkehrende Probleme systematisch und gehst ihren Ursachen auf den Grund.
* Du findest anhand von Maschinentyp, Seriennummer, Stücklisten und Zeichnungen das richtige Ersatzteil und unterstützt den Customer Service bei technisch anspruchsvollen Anfragen.
* Bei Bedarf springst du im Field Service oder in der Montage ein.


Dazu kommen zwei Dinge, die diese Stelle besonders machen:

* Du analysierst wiederkehrende Servicefälle und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab – für Produkt, Ersatzteile, Montage, Qualität und Serviceprozesse. Deine Erkenntnisse gehen direkt an Produktmanagement und Engineering.
* Du organisierst Produktschulungen für Servicetechniker, interne Mitarbeitende, Händler und Kunden – und führst sie zum Teil selbst durch. Teile dein Wissen.


**Was uns wichtig ist**

Wir sind ein kleines Team. Darum zählt, wie wir miteinander arbeiten.

* Wir stehen zu unseren Zusagen. Wenn etwas nicht wie geplant funktioniert, sprechen wir es frühzeitig an.
* Wir sprechen Dinge direkt an – offen und respektvoll. Auch gegenüber dem Chef.
* Wir denken über den eigenen Bereich hinaus und behalten die anderen Teams, den Service und unsere Kunden im Fokus.
* Wir entscheiden selbständig, wo es geht. Fragen, wo es nötig ist.
* Wir wollen uns weiterentwickeln. Wir helfen einander dabei – der Antrieb kommt von jedem selbst.


**Was du bekommst**

* Eine mit Wirkung: Was du am Telefon löst, läuft am nächsten Tag im Tunnel wieder.
* Ein Team, das sich gegenseitig hilft – und Kollegen in Montage und Engineering, die zwei Türen weiter sitzen.
* Einen Vorgesetzten, der dir klare und ehrliche Rückmeldung gibt und dich in deiner Entwicklung unterstützt.
* Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die zu dir passen – ob in Richtung Führung, fachlicher Spezialisierung oder, wenn du möchtest, auch im internationalen Umfeld.


Und das mit attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen: 40\-Stunden\-Woche mit Jahresarbeitszeit, mindestens 25 Ferientage, sehr gute Pensionskassen\-Konditionen, vollständig übernommene Unfall\- und Krankentaggeldversicherung, kostenlose Parkplätze und Vergünstigungen im Mitarbeiterrestaurant.

**Was du mitbringst**

* Eine technische Grundausbildung, zum Beispiel als Polymechaniker:in, Baumaschinen\- oder Landmaschinenmechaniker:in oder Automatiker:in; eine Weiterbildung zum:zur Techniker:in HF ist ein Plus.
* Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Service, in der Instandhaltung oder in der Montage von Maschinen, inkl. Hydraulik und Elektrik. Idealerweise kennst du Baumaschinen oder Spritzbetontechnik.
* Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und Schemata sowie mit einem ERP\-System.
* Du erklärst technische Zusammenhänge so, dass sie auch am Telefon ankommen – ruhig, auch wenn es beim Kunden gerade brennt.
* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; du hast mit Kunden, Händlern und Kollegen aus der ganzen Gruppe zu tun. Weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.


**Was diese Stelle nicht ist**

Kein reiner Bürojob und kein Ticket\-Abarbeiten. Wer hier sitzt, muss die Maschine verstehen, ab und zu selbst Hand anlegen und den Kollegen im Feld etwas zutrauen. Und falls du Sätze wie «Ist nicht mein » und «Haben wir schon immer so gemacht» auch nicht magst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.


**Klingt gut?**

Dann freuen wir uns auf dich. Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt, reichen uns. Du willst dir vorab einen Eindruck verschaffen oder kurz telefonieren? , \+ , nimmt sich gerne Zeit.

En deuxième ligne, vous ferez le lien avec les instances de contrôle, accompagnerez et challengerez les métiers.

En faisant évoluer notre système de contrôle interne (méthodologie, procédures, matrices risques\-contrôles et culture), vous fédérerez les métiers autour des campagnes de revue, vérifierez la conception et l'exécution des contrôles et conviendrez des remédiations. Vous soutiendrez et renforcerez le processus de remontée d'incidents (whistleblowing), de sa diffusion à son suivi.



Vous coordonnerez les mandats d’audit interne confiés à des sociétés externes , du cadrage au rapport final. Personne de référence entre les auditeurs, les divisions et la Direction, vous suivrez la mise en œuvre des recommandations et veillerez à ce que les constats significatifs alimentent le dispositif de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques.



Vous construirez également avec les métiers et le Service juridique l'inventaire des directives, règlements et exigences, puis transformerez les plus prioritaires en contrôles intégrés au système. Vous suivrez les écarts et les plans d'action, garantirez la traçabilité, piloterez les indicateurs et alimenterez de vos synthèses les présentations de votre hiérarchie.
